entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes organization of street railroads, telegraphs, and booming corporations under chapter 351, applying general provisions to other corporate entities.

headings.title: Organization of special corporations under chapter
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes street railroad, telegraph, telephone, booming, rafting, and railroad corporations to organize under this chapter and issue nonpar shares.

headings.title: Applicable chapter provisions for other corporations
headings.reviewNote: Subjects corporations organized under other Missouri laws to designated provisions of this chapter under section 351.690.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes comprehensive corporate document filing requirements with the secretary of state, detailing execution, language, forms, and signatures.

headings.title: General statutory document filing requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires documents to satisfy general and specific statutory standards to be entitled to filing by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Filing authorized or required by chapter
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that documents filed in the office of the secretary of state be required or permitted by this chapter.

headings.title: Mandatory and permissive information in documents
headings.reviewNote: Requires documents to contain all information mandated by this chapter and permits insertion of other lawful information.

headings.title: Typewritten or printed document formatting standard
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that all documents submitted for filing be typewritten or printed.

headings.title: English language requirements and foreign exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires documents to be in English, permitting foreign corporate names and authenticated translations of foreign certificates.

headings.title: Execution authority of officers and fiduciaries
headings.reviewNote: Specifies execution by board chair, president, officers, incorporators prior to organization, or court-appointed fiduciaries.

headings.title: Signature capacity seal and attestation options
headings.reviewNote: Requires signing parties to state name and capacity, permitting corporate seals, assistant secretary attestations, and acknowledgments.

headings.title: Use of prescribed mandatory forms
headings.reviewNote: Mandates using forms prescribed by the secretary of state whenever mandatory forms have been designated.

headings.title: Delivery to secretary and required fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivery of documents to the secretary of state with correct statutory filing fees or penalties.

headings.title: Authorized facsimile and electronic signatures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes facsimile, conformed, or electronically transmitted signatures on filed corporate documents under administrative rules.

headings.title: Truthfulness representation and false swearing penalties
headings.reviewNote: Declares that signing filed documents represents truthfulness under penalty of perjury and false swearing statutes under section 575.040.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs effective dates of filed corporate documents and restricts delayed effective dates to ninety days post-filing.

headings.title: Effective date of accepted corporate filings
headings.reviewNote: Makes filed documents effective upon the endorsement date of filing or at the date specified in the document.

headings.title: Limitation on delayed effective dates
headings.reviewNote: Permits specifying a delayed effective date on filed documents not to exceed ninety days after the filing date.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures, retroactive effective dates, and statutory fees for filing articles of correction to rectify defective corporate records.

headings.title: Authority to correct filed corporate documents
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic and foreign corporations to correct filed documents containing errors or defective executions or acknowledgments.

headings.title: Preparation and delivery of articles of correction
headings.reviewNote: Directs preparation of articles of correction describing the document, specifying errors, and delivering corrections to the secretary.

headings.title: Retroactive effective date and reliance exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Makes articles of correction effective retroactively to original filing dates except as to persons adversely affected by reliance.

headings.title: Statutory filing fee for articles of correction
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a statutory filing fee of five dollars for delivering articles of correction to the secretary of state.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines the secretary of state's ministerial filing duties, endorsement procedures, rejected document explanations, and absence of validity presumptions.

headings.title: Mandatory filing of conforming corporate documents
headings.reviewNote: Mandates filing of delivered documents that satisfy statutory requirements and prescribed formats.

headings.title: Endorsement procedure and return of filed copy
headings.reviewNote: Directs the secretary of state to endorse filed documents upon fee payment and deliver a copy to the corporation.

headings.title: Written explanation upon refusal to file
headings.reviewNote: Requires the secretary of state to return rejected documents with a brief written explanation specifying reasons for refusal.

headings.title: Ministerial nature of secretary filing duty
headings.reviewNote: Declares the duty to file ministerial, creating no presumption regarding document validity or the truth of contained statements.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates mandatory contents of articles of incorporation and authorizes optional provisions including director monetary liability limitations.

headings.title: Mandatory provisions in articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Requires articles to state corporate name, registered office and agent, authorized shares and classes, incorporators, duration, and purposes.

headings.title: Optional provisions and director liability limitations
headings.reviewNote: Permits articles to set board size, limit preemptive rights, restrict director monetary liability for fiduciary duty breaches, and add lawful provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs the delivery, fee payment, filing, and issuance of corporate charters by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Delivery and filing of articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivering signed articles of incorporation to the secretary of state for filing and retention upon fee payment.

headings.title: Issuance and delivery of certificate of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the secretary of state to issue a certificate of incorporation affixed to a duplicate copy and deliver it to the corporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes incorporation fees and share increase taxes, valuing no-par stock at one dollar and providing military fee waivers.

headings.title: Initial incorporation tax and share increase fees
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a $53 fee on the first $30,000 of authorized shares plus $5 per additional $10,000, exempting pre-1943 foreign railroads.

headings.title: Valuation of authorized par and no-par shares
headings.reviewNote: Defines authorized share values as par value for par shares and one dollar per share for shares without par value.

headings.title: Fee waiver for active military and guard members
headings.reviewNote: Waives incorporation fees if a majority shareholder, officer, or director is an active military or Missouri National Guard resident.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes certificates of good standing for domestic and foreign corporations, specifying certificate contents and evidentiary effect.

headings.title: Application for certificate of good standing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any person to apply to the secretary of state for a certificate of good standing for domestic or foreign corporations.

headings.title: Required contents of domestic good standing certificate
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that domestic certificates state corporate name, incorporation date, Missouri organization, and regulatory compliance.

headings.title: Required contents of foreign good standing certificate
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that foreign certificates state home name, Missouri registered name, jurisdiction of incorporation, and compliance.

headings.title: Prima facie evidence of corporate existence
headings.reviewNote: Makes certificates of good standing prima facie evidence of corporate existence or foreign authorization to transact business.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs organizational meetings of incorporators to adopt bylaws and elect initial directors, and initial board meetings to elect officers and organize corporate affairs.

headings.title: Incorporator organizational powers and initial board
headings.reviewNote: Empowers incorporators to adopt original bylaws and name initial directors if not named in articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Initial organizational meeting of board of directors
headings.reviewNote: Provides for initial board of directors meeting upon call of incorporators to elect officers, act on share subscriptions, authorize share issuance, perfect organization, and transact other business.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs amendments to articles of incorporation by directors before share payment and by shareholders, setting cumulative voting and control share thresholds.

headings.title: Board amendment before receipt of share payment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board of directors to amend articles of incorporation before the corporation receives any payment for shares.

headings.title: Procedure for shareholder adoption of article amendments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes board resolution, notice, and majority shareholder voting requirements for adopting amendments to articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Restrictions on decreasing directors under cumulative voting
headings.reviewNote: Protects cumulative voting representation by prohibiting decreasing the board to fewer than three directors against minority opposition.

headings.title: Capital reduction compliance upon article amendment
headings.reviewNote: Requires compliance with stated capital reduction statutes whenever article amendments effectuate capital reductions.

headings.title: Submission of multiple amendments at one meeting
headings.reviewNote: Permits submitting any number of proposed article amendments to shareholders for voting at a single meeting.

headings.title: Two-thirds vote required for control share opt-outs
headings.reviewNote: Requires a two-thirds vote of outstanding shares to adopt amendments making section 351.407 control share laws inapplicable.

headings.title: Supermajority vote required to abolish cumulative voting
headings.reviewNote: Requires a two-thirds shareholder vote to abolish cumulative voting in corporations having ten or fewer shareholders.

entries.reviewSummary: Guarantees class and series voting rights on proposed article amendments that adversely alter share authorizations, preferences, or rights.

headings.title: Mandatory class voting on adverse article amendments
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees class voting rights on amendments altering authorized shares, par value, superior preferences, or special rights adversely.

headings.title: Series voting rights on adverse series alterations
headings.reviewNote: Grants series voting rights when an amendment adversely affects the powers or preferences of a specific series rather than the entire class.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes the execution, contents, and filing requirements for certificates of amendment adopted by directors or shareholders.

headings.title: Certificate of amendment executed by board of directors
headings.reviewNote: Directs directors to execute a certificate of amendment stating corporate name, adoption date, amendment text, and nonpayment for shares.

headings.title: Certificate of amendment executed by corporate officer
headings.reviewNote: Requires officer execution of shareholder-approved certificates of amendment detailing voting totals, class votes, and share reclassifications.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs regulatory examination, filing, fee collection, and issuance of certificates of amendment by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Examination filing and certificate issuance by secretary
headings.reviewNote: Directs the secretary of state to examine duplicate certificates of amendment, file records upon fee payment, and issue certified copies.

headings.title: Delivery of certified amendment to corporation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the secretary of state to return the certified copy of the certificate of amendment to the corporation or its representative.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs cooperative organization, organizer representation, initial director selection, and board organizational meetings.

headings.title: Organization of cooperatives by persons or entities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes one or more persons or business entities to organize cooperatives, providing that organizers need not be members.

headings.title: Adoption of bylaws and initial board selection
headings.reviewNote: Empowers organizers by majority vote or unanimous consent to adopt bylaws and select initial directors if omitted from articles.

headings.title: Organizational meeting of cooperative board of directors
headings.reviewNote: Requires the cooperative board to hold an organizational meeting to elect officers, adopt bylaws, and finalize organization.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes naming requirements for cooperatives, mandatory organizational words, governmental implications bar, and distinguishable name standards.

headings.title: Required cooperative naming terms and restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Requires cooperative names to include specific organizational designations and prohibits words implying governmental agency status.

headings.title: Distinguishable cooperative name requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires cooperative names to be distinguishable on secretary of state records from other registered business entities.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs contents, execution, filing fees, formation presumptions, and pre-formation transaction prohibitions for cooperative articles.

headings.title: Mandatory and optional contents of cooperative articles
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents in articles including name, purposes, organizers, effective date, registered office, agent, and duration.

headings.title: Filing of articles and statutory filing fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing articles of organization with the secretary of state along with a statutory one hundred dollar filing fee.

headings.title: Formation of legal entity upon filing
headings.reviewNote: Establishes corporate existence upon filing and endorsement by the secretary of state, creating statutory presumptions of compliance.

headings.title: Prohibition on transacting business prior to formation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits cooperatives from transacting business before formation articles are stamped filed by the secretary of state.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs procedures for amending cooperative articles of incorporation, member approval votes, execution standards, and filing fees.

headings.title: Board resolution and member voting on amendments
headings.reviewNote: Outlines amendment procedures requiring board resolutions, member notice, and majority member vote at meetings or alternative ballots.

headings.title: Preparation and execution of articles of amendment
headings.reviewNote: Directs preparation of articles of amendment stating cooperative name, text, effective date, and compliance, signed by an officer.

headings.title: Filing fee and certificate of amendment issuance
headings.reviewNote: Sets a twenty dollar filing fee and requires the secretary of state to file conforming amendments and issue certificates.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the commencement date of cooperative existence upon filing and provides default perpetual duration.

headings.title: Commencement date of cooperative existence
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that cooperative corporate existence begins when articles are filed with the secretary of state unless a delayed date is specified.

headings.title: Perpetual duration default for cooperatives
headings.reviewNote: Provides that cooperatives have perpetual duration unless a limited period of existence is explicitly stated in the articles.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates continuous maintenance of cooperative registered offices and agents, detailing change procedures, resignations, and service of process.

headings.title: Continuous maintenance of registered office and agent
headings.reviewNote: Requires each cooperative to continuously maintain a registered office with a street address and a registered agent in Missouri.

headings.title: Procedure for changing registered office or agent
headings.reviewNote: Governs the process for changing registered offices or agents by filing a statement of change with the secretary of state.

headings.title: Execution, filing, and effective time of change statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires change statement to be signed by an officer or director, delivered to the secretary of state, stamped 'Filed', and effective upon filing.

headings.title: Mandatory agent change upon vacancy or disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Requires a cooperative to change its registered agent if the agent is no longer at the registered office, is dissolved, dies, becomes incapacitated, or has its appointment revoked.

headings.title: Registered agent resignation statement and termination
headings.reviewNote: Sets required contents of a registered agent's signed resignation statement and terminates the agency on the earlier of thirty days after receipt by the secretary of state or appointment of a new agent.

headings.title: Secretary of state service upon agent default
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service of process upon the secretary of state when cooperatives fail to maintain registered agents in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs cooperative bylaws, mandatory and optional contents, adoption timing, board and member amendment procedures, and emergency bylaws.

headings.title: Requirement for cooperative bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Requires every cooperative to have bylaws governing its business affairs, structure, member qualifications and rights, and membership interests.

headings.title: Mandatory and optional bylaw provisions
headings.reviewNote: Lists mandatory bylaw terms (purpose, capital structure, tax classification, governance and voting rights, transfer restrictions, profit/loss allocation, distributions, and patronage records) and permits additional management provisions.

headings.title: Timing of bylaw adoption and conversion exception
headings.reviewNote: Requires bylaws to be adopted before accepting member contributions, with a post-filing adoption exception for entities converting into cooperatives.

headings.title: Board authority to amend bylaws and member notice
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board to amend bylaws without member approval unless reserved to members or prohibited by bylaw, and requires notice or summary of amendments to members.

headings.title: Member amendment of bylaws at meetings
headings.reviewNote: Allows members to amend bylaws at regular or special meetings upon notice, quorum (including mail or alternative ballots), and majority or specified supermajority vote.

headings.title: Emergency bylaws and good-faith immunity
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board adoption of emergency bylaws effective during catastrophic events preventing a quorum, keeps consistent regular bylaws operative, and grants immunity for good-faith actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates permanent minutes, accounting records, and principal-office records for cooperatives, and regulates good-faith member inspection rights and confidentiality exclusions.

headings.title: Required permanent, accounting, and principal-office records
headings.reviewNote: Requires permanent minutes, actions, and waivers, accounting records, principal-office records (articles, bylaws, member/officer lists, and four years of financial statements and tax returns), board retention/confidentiality policies, and allows electronic storage.

headings.title: Member inspection rights and confidential record exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Grants members inspection on three days' written notice in good faith for a proper purpose, excluding other members' equity/patronage data, receivables, personnel records, court-ordered or third-party confidential records, legally protected data (including PHI), and trade secrets.

entries.reviewSummary: Enumerates additional cooperative powers including acting as member agent, contracting, property and facility rights, borrowing, member advances, donations, loans/investments, employee benefits, insurance, and entity ownership.

headings.title: General incidental and business entity powers
headings.reviewNote: Grants all powers necessary or convenient to achieve cooperative purposes and all consistent rights and powers of Missouri business entities.

headings.title: Acting as agent for members without nonperformance liability
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes acting as agent or representative for members in procuring goods, services, or programs without liability for member nonperformance unless affirmatively accepted.

headings.title: Contracting and management agreement authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes making contracts for the cooperative or its members, including pricing, supply/sales agreements, and third-party management contracts.

headings.title: Acquiring, holding, encumbering, and conveying property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes acquiring, holding, leasing, encumbering, and conveying real, personal, and intellectual property and contract rights.

headings.title: Owning, leasing, and constructing buildings and facilities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes owning, leasing, constructing, and developing buildings, facilities, and improvements on cooperative property or rights-of-way.

headings.title: Issuing debt, borrowing, encumbering assets, and guarantees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing bonds and debt obligations, borrowing money, mortgaging or encumbering property or income, and issuing guarantees.

headings.title: Advances to members or patrons on delivered products
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes making advances to members or patrons on products or services delivered by them to the cooperative.

headings.title: Accepting donations and deposits from cooperatives and members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes accepting donations or deposits of money or property from constituent cooperatives and members.

headings.title: Loans, borrowing, and investment of cooperative funds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes loaning and borrowing money with members or constituent cooperatives and investing or reinvesting cooperative funds.

headings.title: Pensions, employee benefit plans, and fiduciary indemnification
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes paying pensions, establishing employee or incentive benefit plans and trusts, and indemnifying or insuring plan fiduciaries.

headings.title: Providing and owning insurance for personnel and members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes providing and owning insurance of any kind for employees, officers, directors, members, and managers.

headings.title: Ownership and formation of subsidiary or affiliated entities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes acquiring, forming, and holding ownership interests in subsidiary, affiliated, or special purpose business entities.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes emergency board succession and office relocation, relaxed meeting notice and officer-as-director quorum rules, good-faith action immunity, and defines catastrophic emergencies.

headings.title: Emergency succession lines and office relocation authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board in anticipation of or during an emergency to modify lines of succession and relocate or designate alternative principal or regional offices.

headings.title: Emergency board notice and officers deemed directors for quorum
headings.reviewNote: Permits emergency board meeting notice by any practicable means (including publication, radio, or email) and deems present officers directors in rank and seniority order as needed for a quorum.

headings.title: Binding effect and immunity for good-faith emergency actions
headings.reviewNote: Makes good-faith emergency actions binding on the cooperative and bars imposing liability on directors, officers, or employees for unauthorized action.

headings.title: Definition of catastrophic emergency
headings.reviewNote: Defines an emergency for purposes of this section as an inability to readily obtain a quorum of the board of directors because of a catastrophic event.

entries.reviewSummary: Vests cooperative governance in the board, sets majority voting and collective action rules, defines director fiduciary duty, and permits third-party management agreements.

headings.title: Board governance subject to manager or member powers
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a cooperative is governed by its board of directors except for actions reserved or granted to a manager or members by law, articles, or bylaws.

headings.title: Majority board voting and bar on individual director action
headings.reviewNote: Requires board action by majority vote at a duly called meeting with a quorum unless bylaws require a greater vote, and prohibits unauthorized individual director action.

headings.title: Director advocacy and collective fiduciary duty
headings.reviewNote: Allows a director to advocate for particular member groups while maintaining a fiduciary duty to represent the cooperative and all members collectively.

headings.title: Third-party management service agreements permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board of directors to enter into management service agreements with third parties.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs initial organizer-elected boards, director qualifications, patron-elected majority, voting allocation, terms, resignations, district elections, mail/alternative ballots, and non-natural-person member appointees.

headings.title: Initial board election by organizers and interim vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Requires organizers to elect the first board under section 351.1009(2) and authorizes the board to fill interim vacancies until members elect directors.

headings.title: Director terms, patron-elected majority, voting power, and proxies
headings.reviewNote: Governs director terms, patron-member election of a board majority with at least half of board voting power, holdover validity, compensation, classes, resignation, and ban on director proxy voting.

headings.title: Election at regular members' meetings or by written consent
headings.reviewNote: Requires electing directors at regular members' meetings or by written consent, except vacancy elections held at special meetings.

headings.title: District or unit nomination and election of directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes nominating and electing directors on a district or unit basis at district meetings as provided in the articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Voting for directors by mail or alternative ballot
headings.reviewNote: Permits voting for directors by mail ballot or authorized alternative ballot and sets procedures for ballot delivery, receipt, and counting.

headings.title: Natural-person appointees of entity members eligible as directors
headings.reviewNote: Allows a non-natural-person member to appoint or elect one or more natural persons who are eligible for election as directors.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs the effective date of corporate amendments, authorizing deferred effective dates and preserving existing claims and suits.

headings.title: Effective date of general corporate amendments
headings.reviewNote: Makes certificates of amendment effective upon issuance by the secretary of state or at a deferred date up to ninety days post-filing.

headings.title: Preservation of existing rights and pending litigation
headings.reviewNote: Preserves existing causes of action, pending suits, third-party rights, and corporate liabilities unaffected by article amendments.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes board procedures for appointing interim directors to fill vacancies among patron and non-patron director positions.

headings.title: Filling vacancies among patron member directors
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board in consultation with patron directors to appoint interim successors for patron director vacancies until member elections.

headings.title: Filling vacancies among non-patron directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remaining directors by majority vote to fill non-patron director vacancies until the next member election.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedures for removing cooperative directors by board or member vote, protecting classified boards and electing replacements.

headings.title: Default application of statutory director removal rules
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory director removal rules unless modified by cooperative articles of incorporation or bylaws.

headings.title: Removal of directors by board of directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes removal of directors by majority board vote for disqualification or agreement breach, or by unanimous vote without cause.

headings.title: Removal of directors by vote of membership
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members to remove directors with or without cause by majority vote of the class or unit that elected the director.

headings.title: Removal for cause in classified boards
headings.reviewNote: Permits members to remove classified directors only for cause by majority vote of members eligible to elect them.

headings.title: Election of replacement directors at removal meeting
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members to elect new directors to fill vacancies at the same meeting where director removals are voted.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs cooperative board meetings, conference calls, notice periods, waivers of notice, and advance written voting by directors.

headings.title: Location and call of board meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes holding board meetings within or without Missouri at places selected by the board or at the principal executive office.

headings.title: Conference communications constituting meetings
headings.reviewNote: Deems conference communications allowing simultaneous audio participation to constitute valid meetings with in-person presence.

headings.title: Notice requirements for calling board meetings
headings.reviewNote: Requires ten days' written notice for regular meetings and three days' notice for organizational meetings unless bylaws provide otherwise.

headings.title: Previously scheduled and adjourned meeting notices
headings.reviewNote: Eliminates notice requirements for meetings scheduled in articles or bylaws or announced at previously convened board meetings.

headings.title: Waiver of notice by written consent or attendance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes written or oral waivers of notice and deems meeting attendance a waiver absent prompt jurisdictional objection.

headings.title: Advance written consent or opposition to proposals
headings.reviewNote: Permits absent directors to submit advance written votes on specific proposals if authorized by articles or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes cooperative board action by written consent without a meeting, establishing signing thresholds, effective timing, and notice requirements.

headings.title: Board action by written consent permitted
headings.reviewNote: Details when board action may be taken by written action signed by the required number or majority of directors.

headings.title: Effective time of written action
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that written action takes effect when signed by the required number of directors unless another time is provided.

headings.title: Notice to non-signing directors and liability
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice to non-signing directors and shields non-signing or non-consenting directors from liability for the action.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs the establishment, procedures, and minutes of board committees, including litigation committees and committee member standards.

headings.title: Establishment, procedures, and minutes of committees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes committee establishment, litigation committees, meeting procedures, and access rules for committee minutes.

headings.title: Committee action and director standard compliance
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that committee establishment, delegation, or action does not alone constitute director compliance with conduct standards.

headings.title: Committee members considered directors
headings.reviewNote: Treats committee members as directors for duties, conflicts, and indemnification, with exceptions for independent members.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes conflict-of-interest disclosure, board ratification, fairness standards, and a director's first duty of loyalty to share business opportunities with the cooperative.

headings.title: Standard of conduct and good faith
headings.reviewNote: Requires directors to discharge duties in good faith, in the best interests of the cooperative, with ordinary prudent care.

headings.title: Reliance on officers, experts, and committees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director reliance on reports and opinions of officers, employees, legal counsel, accountants, and committees.

headings.title: Presumption of assent and dissent procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes presumption that present directors assent to board actions unless proper written dissent or abstention is recorded.

headings.title: First duty of loyalty and corporate opportunity sharing
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a director's first duty of loyalty to the cooperative and requires sharing business knowledge and opportunities first with the cooperative before pursuing them personally if declined.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates director conflicts of interest and defines conditions under which transactions with interested directors are valid.

headings.title: Validity of director conflict transactions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that interested director contracts are not voidable if fair and reasonable with proper disclosure, approval, or equal terms.

headings.title: Material financial interest definition and attribution
headings.reviewNote: Defines material financial interest and attributes transactions involving family members directly to the director.

entries.reviewSummary: Permits charter or bylaw limitations on director monetary liability and specifies mandatory exceptions that cannot be limited.

headings.title: Elimination or limitation of director liability
headings.reviewNote: Allows cooperative articles or bylaws to eliminate or limit personal monetary liability of directors for breach of duty.

headings.title: Exceptions to limitation of director liability
headings.reviewNote: Lists mandatory exceptions where director liability cannot be eliminated, including bad faith, loyalty breaches, and illegal distributions.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive indemnification statute for cooperative officials, covering expense advances, insurance, and determination procedures.

headings.title: Application of statutory definitions
headings.reviewNote: States that statutory definitions in this subsection govern the cooperative indemnification section.

headings.title: Definitions for indemnification provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines cooperative, official capacity, and proceeding for cooperative indemnification purposes.

headings.title: Permitted indemnification and standard of conduct
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to members of any board-approved bylaw amendment under this section, including amendment text or summary, within a specified period (source note: 'Subsection 1' appears in original rolls at 'subsection 2').

headings.title: Advance payment or reimbursement of expenses
headings.reviewNote: Establishes entitlement to advance expense payments upon written affirmation and repayment undertaking.

headings.title: Charter and bylaw indemnification restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Allows articles or bylaws to restrict or condition indemnification and expense advances prospectively.

headings.title: Witness expense reimbursement permitted
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that witness expense reimbursement is not prohibited or limited for non-party appearances.

headings.title: Determination procedure for indemnification
headings.reviewNote: Specifies determination procedures by disinterested directors, special legal counsel, or members.

headings.title: Liability insurance coverage authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cooperative to purchase and maintain liability insurance for persons serving in official capacities.

headings.title: Indemnification of other persons by contract
headings.reviewNote: Preserves cooperative authority to indemnify other persons by contract or otherwise beyond listed officials.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs election of cooperative officers, combination of offices, and employment and authority of chief executive officers.

headings.title: Election of chair, president, and secretary
headings.reviewNote: Provides for board election of chair, vice chairs, president, and secretary, and limits officer binding authority.

headings.title: Election of additional officers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to elect additional officers as authorized or required in articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Combination of president and secretary offices
headings.reviewNote: Permits combining the offices of president and secretary in the same individual.

headings.title: Employment and authority of chief executive officer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes employment of chief executive officer to manage day-to-day affairs subject to board limits.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets statutory rules for cooperative membership, grouping into districts, membership interest characteristics, and member liability.

headings.title: Cooperative membership requirement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that a cooperative shall have one or more members.

headings.title: Member grouping by districts or units
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes grouping members into districts or units and holding unit meetings to elect delegates.

headings.title: Membership interest as personal property
headings.reviewNote: Classifies membership interests as personal property and clarifies members have no interest in specific cooperative property.

headings.title: Alteration of authorized membership interest amounts
headings.reviewNote: Provides for increasing, decreasing, or altering authorized amounts of patron and nonpatron membership interests.

headings.title: Issuance terms and payment requirement
headings.reviewNote: Governs issuance terms and requires full payment in money or approved property before membership interest issuance.

headings.title: Patron membership financial rights percentage
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees patron membership interests collectively not less than fifty percent of cooperative financial rights.

headings.title: Patron membership interest characteristics
headings.reviewNote: Establishes standard characteristics of patron membership interests regarding classes, voting, and profit sharing.

headings.title: Issuance of nonpatron membership interests
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cooperative to solicit and issue nonpatron membership interests on board-determined terms.

headings.title: Limited member liability and subscription debts
headings.reviewNote: Shields members from personal liability for cooperative debts while preserving liability for unpaid subscriptions.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes division of cooperative membership interests into classes or series and establishment of relative rights and preferences.

headings.title: Classes and series of membership interests
headings.reviewNote: Permits dividing membership interests into classes or series with distinct redemption, distribution, conversion, or voting rights.

headings.title: Establishment of relative rights and preferences
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes setting rights and preferences in articles, bylaws, or board resolutions with external facts or agreement references.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates certificated and uncertificated membership interests, certificate execution, required disclosures, and evidential weight.

headings.title: Certificated and uncertificated membership interests
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that membership interests may be certificated or uncertificated and holders of certificated interests are entitled to certificates.

headings.title: Signatures required on membership certificates
headings.reviewNote: Requires certificates to be signed by an authorized officer, CEO, president, secretary, or board chairman.

headings.title: Validity of former officer signatures
headings.reviewNote: Validates certificates signed by authorized persons who cease to hold office before actual issuance.

headings.title: Required contents on membership certificates
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates mandatory statements on certificate faces, including name, organization laws, class, series, and transfer restrictions.

headings.title: Certificate as prima facie ownership evidence
headings.reviewNote: Declares properly signed membership certificates to be prima facie evidence of interest ownership.

headings.title: Board authorization of uncertificated interests
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes uncertificated membership interests by board resolution, requiring written disclosure notices to members.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes replacement certificates for lost, stolen, or destroyed cooperative membership certificates and voids original certificates.

headings.title: Replacement of lost or destroyed certificates
headings.reviewNote: Allows issuance of replacement membership certificates upon filing an affidavit of lost, stolen, or destroyed certificate.

headings.title: Replaced certificate void and no overissue
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that replacement certificate does not create an overissue and automatically renders replaced certificate void.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes requirements for annual regular members' meetings, officer reports, director elections, meeting notices, and notice waivers.

headings.title: Annual regular members' meeting timing
headings.reviewNote: Requires regular members' meeting to be held annually at a time determined by the board or bylaws.

headings.title: Location of regular members' meeting
headings.reviewNote: Provides that annual members' meeting be held at principal place of business or other location determined by bylaws or board.

headings.title: Officer reports on business and finances
headings.reviewNote: Requires officers to submit reports to members at annual meeting covering previous fiscal year business and finances.

headings.title: Election of directors at annual meeting
headings.reviewNote: Directs that directors be elected at annual members' meeting for prescribed terms, except district or unit delegates.

headings.title: Notice timing and bylaw amendment summaries
headings.reviewNote: Establishes meeting notice timing and requires summary of board-adopted bylaw amendments since last meeting.

headings.title: Waiver of notice for members' meeting
headings.reviewNote: Specifies methods and legal effect of waiver of notice by members, including attendance without objection.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs call, notice issuance timelines, and notice waiver rules for special members' meetings in cooperatives.

headings.title: Call of special members' meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes call of special members' meetings by board members or petition of twenty percent of members or interests.

headings.title: Notice and timing for special meetings
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice stating time, place, and purpose issued within ten days and held within thirty days of petition.

headings.title: Waiver of notice for special meeting
headings.reviewNote: Governs written, oral, or attendance-based waiver of notice for special members' meetings.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes quorum requirements for cooperative members' meetings, mail ballot quorum counting, and invalidity in absence of quorum.

headings.title: Quorum percentage for members' meetings
headings.reviewNote: Sets default quorum at ten percent of total members and forbids bylaws from lowering quorum below ten percent.

headings.title: Counting mail ballots and quorum verification
headings.reviewNote: Provides for counting mail and alternative ballots toward quorum and requiring verification recorded in minutes.

headings.title: Invalidity of action without quorum
headings.reviewNote: Declares that member action taken in the absence of a quorum is not valid or legal.

entries.reviewSummary: Permits regular and special members' meetings by remote communication, setting verification standards and electronic notice waiver rules.

headings.title: Remote communication meetings authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes holding member meetings by remote communication when permitted by articles, bylaws, or board resolution.

headings.title: Verification and participation measures required
headings.reviewNote: Requires reasonable measures to verify member identity and provide concurrent hearing, speaking, and voting opportunities.

headings.title: Electronic waiver of notice and attendance
headings.reviewNote: Provides for waiver of notice via authenticated electronic communication and waiver by remote participation.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes general voting standards for cooperative members, separate class or series vote requirements, and greater quorum rules.

headings.title: Majority vote requirement for member action
headings.reviewNote: Requires member action to be taken by affirmative majority vote of voting power present at a meeting with a quorum.

headings.title: Separate voting requirement by class or series
headings.reviewNote: Mandates separate majority approval of each class or series entitled to vote on a matter as a class or series.

headings.title: Greater quorum or voting requirements
headings.reviewNote: Allows articles or bylaws to impose greater quorum or vote rules and governs procedures for amending those rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes cooperative member action by written consent or authenticated electronic communication without a meeting.

headings.title: Member action by written or electronic consent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes member action by written or electronic consent, establishing voting thresholds based on charter or bylaw provisions.

headings.title: Effective time of member written action
headings.reviewNote: Provides that written or electronic member action takes effect when signed by required members unless otherwise specified.

headings.title: Notice to non-signing members and liability
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice of non-unanimous written action to all members and shields non-consenting members from resulting liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs cooperative member voting rights, patron voting majority, delegate representation, record dates, nonmember governance rights, joint ownership, split voting, and electronic ballot revocation.

headings.title: Patron and nonpatron member voting rights
headings.reviewNote: Sets default rule of one vote per patron member, permits patronage-based votes, and binds patron members to collective votes.

headings.title: Authorized methods for casting member votes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes voting in person, by mail, by alternative ballot, or by proxy as authorized by the board or bylaws.

headings.title: Proxy appointment requirements and duration
headings.reviewNote: Regulates member appointment of proxies in writing or electronically and establishes maximum duration and revocability.

headings.title: Delegate representation and voting for districts or units
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes articles or bylaws to provide for delegate representation and voting for units, districts, or classifications, including counting delegate votes on fundamental transactions.

headings.title: Board authority to fix meeting record date
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board to fix a record date not more than sixty days before a members' meeting to determine members entitled to notice and to vote.

headings.title: Governance rights of creditors or nonmembers
headings.reviewNote: Provides that creditors, security holders, or other nonmembers have no governance rights except as provided in the articles, bylaws, or statute.

headings.title: Voting of jointly owned membership interests
headings.reviewNote: Sets rules for casting a single vote on jointly owned membership interests, including notice denying authority and invalidation of conflicting votes.

headings.title: Split voting of nonpatron or multi-vote patron interests
headings.reviewNote: Permits holders of nonpatron membership interests or multi-vote patron interests to split their votes as provided in the articles or bylaws.

headings.title: Revocation of electronic ballots, votes, or consents
headings.reviewNote: Allows members to revoke electronic ballots, votes, or consents by written revocation or by attending and voting in person at the meeting.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes additional votes for patron members and district delegates based on patronage volume, cooperative membership, or equity.

headings.title: Additional votes for patron members
headings.reviewNote: Permits articles or bylaws to grant additional votes based on business transacted, member count, or equity held.

headings.title: Additional votes for unit or district delegates
headings.reviewNote: Allows cooperatives organized into units or districts to authorize additional votes for elected delegates based on patronage or equity.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates board authority to transfer cooperative assets without member approval, member approval rules for substantial dispositions, and transferee liabilities.

headings.title: Board authority to transfer assets without member approval
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to dispose of assets in ordinary course, encumber assets, or transfer property to wholly owned subsidiaries.

headings.title: Member approval for substantial asset disposition
headings.reviewNote: Requires member approval and specific meeting notice for disposition of all or substantially all assets outside the ordinary course.

headings.title: Transferee liability for transferor obligations
headings.reviewNote: Limits transferee liability for cooperative debts and obligations to terms provided by contract or applicable law.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs restrictions on transfer of membership and financial rights, charging orders by judgment creditors, and rights upon member death or dissolution.

headings.title: Restrictions on transfer of membership interests
headings.reviewNote: Permits transfer restrictions in articles, bylaws, or member agreements, protecting pre-existing holders who did not consent.

headings.title: Cooperative right of first purchase
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes right of first purchase for cooperative or patron members and renders repurchased membership interests null and void.

headings.title: Transfer of member financial rights
headings.reviewNote: Provides that financial rights are transferable without dissolving cooperative, but transfer does not confer governance rights.

headings.title: Restrictions on assignment of financial rights
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes restrictions on assignment of financial rights and requires two-thirds member vote to amend or remove restrictions.

headings.title: Charging orders against member financial rights
headings.reviewNote: Establishes charging orders as sole remedy of judgment creditors against financial rights while preserving statutory exemptions.

headings.title: Member death, incapacity, bankruptcy, and dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes legal representatives to exercise rights for estate administration and grants cooperative first right of repurchase.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates board authorization for accepting contributions and contribution agreements, permissible contribution forms, acceptance and record requirements, and good-faith valuation presumptions.

headings.title: Board authorization for contributions and contribution agreements
headings.reviewNote: Requires board authorization to accept patron or nonpatron contributions and to enter into contribution agreements under section 351.1138 and contribution rights agreements under section 351.1141.

headings.title: Permissible forms of member contributions
headings.reviewNote: Permits contributions in money, property transfers, services rendered, or a signed written obligation to pay money, transfer property, or perform services.

headings.title: Board acceptance and record entry required for valid contribution
headings.reviewNote: Requires board acceptance describing the contribution, performance terms, and accorded value, plus entry in required cooperative records, for a purported contribution to count.

headings.title: Presumption of proper good-faith board valuation
headings.reviewNote: Presumes good-faith board determinations of fair value, fairness, and payment or performance terms using reasonable accounting or valuation methods are proper.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs contribution agreements, irrevocability periods, payment call schedules, default collection remedies, and assignment restrictions.

headings.title: Written contribution agreement requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires contribution agreements to be in writing and signed by the would-be contributor to be enforceable.

headings.title: Irrevocability period for contribution agreements
headings.reviewNote: Makes pre-organization contribution agreements irrevocable for six months unless otherwise provided or unanimously released.

headings.title: Payment calls and contribution schedule
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that contribution payments and performance are due according to agreement terms or board calls.

headings.title: Default remedies and cancellation of interests
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes debt collection, cash substitute demands, and cancellation of interests upon twenty days' notice of default.

headings.title: Restrictions on assignment of contribution agreements
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits assignment of contributor rights without board approval or unanimous written consent of members.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes contribution rights agreements, prescribes writing and disclosure requirements, and restricts assignment to nonmembers.

headings.title: Contribution rights agreements authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cooperatives to enter into contribution rights agreements under terms and conditions fixed by the board.

headings.title: Written agreement requirements and terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires contribution rights agreements to be in writing and set forth or incorporate all terms and conditions.

headings.title: Restrictions on assignment to nonmembers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits assignment of contribution rights to nonmembers without unanimous written consent of all members.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates allocation of profits and losses and distribution of cash or assets between patron membership interests and other members.

headings.title: Allocation of profits and losses
headings.reviewNote: Governs allocation of profits and losses, establishing mandatory minimum percentages for patron membership interests.

headings.title: Distribution of cash or cooperative assets
headings.reviewNote: Regulates distribution of cash and assets, requiring patron member distributions to meet minimum statutory percentages.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive statute governing cooperative net income, capital reserves, annual patronage distributions, forms of payment, and nonmember credits.

headings.title: Capital reserve set aside from net income
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to set aside a portion of net income allocated to patron members to maintain a capital reserve.

headings.title: Promotional and capital reserves authorization
headings.reviewNote: Permits board to establish reserves for promotion, ongoing capital needs, and advancement of cooperative business purposes.

headings.title: Patronage distribution and pooling arrangements
headings.reviewNote: Requires excess net income distribution based on patronage and authorizes functional or divisional pooling arrangements.

headings.title: Annual net income distribution requirement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that distribution of net income occur at least annually and requires board report at annual meeting.

headings.title: Permitted forms of net income distribution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes distribution in cash, capital credits, patronage equities, revolving fund certificates, scrip, or securities.

headings.title: Member agreement on distribution tax treatment
headings.reviewNote: Allows bylaws or agreements to obligate members to accept board-determined tax treatment of distributions.

headings.title: Nonmember patron participation in distributions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bylaws to permit nonmember patrons to participate in net income distributions on equal or unequal terms.

headings.title: Refund credits for nonmember patrons
headings.reviewNote: Provides for crediting refunds of ineligible nonmembers to individual accounts and issuing certificates of interest.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedure for reserving exclusive rights to corporate names with the secretary of state and transferring reservations.

headings.title: Eligibility to reserve corporate name
headings.reviewNote: Lists categories of domestic and foreign corporations and organizers entitled to reserve exclusive rights to a corporate name.

headings.title: Filing application and reservation duration
headings.reviewNote: Governs reservation application filing, sixty-day reservation periods, and the one-hundred-eighty-day maximum duration limit.

headings.title: Transfer of reserved corporate name
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transfer of reserved corporate name by filing notice of transfer with the secretary of state.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes cooperatives to retain or donate unclaimed property in lieu of state escheat and defines conditions for extinguishing owner rights.

headings.title: Treatment of unclaimed cooperative property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cooperatives to distribute unclaimed property to tax-exempt entities or retain it as operational reserves.

headings.title: Extinguishment of owner rights in property
headings.reviewNote: Specifies conditions under which owner rights in unclaimed property are extinguished after notice and two years without response.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive merger and consolidation statute for cooperatives, defining terms, plan preparation, member approval, filings, and legal effects.

headings.title: Definitions for merger and consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Defines consolidated entity, merging entity, new entity, and surviving entity for cooperative mergers.

headings.title: Merger and consolidation authority permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic cooperatives to merge or consolidate with each other or with other domestic or foreign business entities.

headings.title: Preparation and contents of merger plan
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes required terms of written merger or consolidation plan, including tax structure elections and interest conversions.

headings.title: Notice of merger plan to members
headings.reviewNote: Requires board to transmit full text of merger plan and meeting notice to members entitled to vote.

headings.title: Adoption, filing, and effective date
headings.reviewNote: Governs quorum, member voting approval, filing articles of merger, effective timing, and certificate issuance.

headings.title: Legal effect of merger or consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Details cessation of separate existence, transfer of rights and property, assumption of liabilities, and Subchapter T continuation.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs short-form merger of ninety-percent subsidiaries into parent cooperatives or sister subsidiaries without member vote.

headings.title: Short-form subsidiary merger requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes merger of ninety-percent subsidiaries without member vote upon board adoption of a detailed plan of merger.

headings.title: Notice of short-form merger to members
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice and copy of merger plan to each non-parent member within ten days of effective date.

headings.title: Preparation and contents of articles of merger
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents of articles of merger, including entity domiciles, merger plan, and parent approval.

headings.title: Execution and filing of articles of merger
headings.reviewNote: Requires articles of merger to be signed on behalf of parent cooperative and filed with secretary of state.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of merger
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to issue certificate of merger to surviving entity or legal representative.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs abandonment of cooperative merger plans before the effective date by member vote, board resolution, and abandonment filings.

headings.title: Abandonment of merger plan by member vote
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes abandonment of approved merger plan before effective date by same vote that approved the plan.

headings.title: Board abandonment of merger plan
headings.reviewNote: Allows boards of merging or surviving domestic or foreign entities to abandon merger plan subject to contract rights.

headings.title: Filing articles of abandonment with state
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing articles of abandonment with secretary of state if articles of merger were filed but not yet effective.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes board duties upon filing intent to dissolve, asset disposition without member vote, and distribution of remaining property.

headings.title: Board duties to collect debts and pay liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Directs board following notice of intent to dissolve to collect debts and pay or provide for all cooperative liabilities.

headings.title: Asset disposition without member vote during dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to sell, lease, or dispose of substantially all cooperative property without member approval after filing intent to dissolve.

headings.title: Distribution of remaining property to members
headings.reviewNote: Requires distribution of remaining assets to members and former members pursuant to articles, bylaws, or patronage records.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides procedures for revoking cooperative dissolution proceedings by member vote before articles of dissolution are filed.

headings.title: Revocation permitted before articles of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Permits revocation of cooperative dissolution proceedings at any time before articles of dissolution are filed.

headings.title: Member meeting and vote on dissolution revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to call members' meeting where dissolution revocation is approved by majority of members.

headings.title: Effective date of revocation and notice filing
headings.reviewNote: Provides that revocation of dissolution takes effect when a notice of revocation is filed with the secretary of state, after which the cooperative may resume business.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs filing of articles of dissolution, required liability certifications, dissolution effective timing, and certificate issuance.

headings.title: Filing and required contents of dissolution articles
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing articles of dissolution certifying payment of debts, asset distribution, and absence of pending litigation.

headings.title: Effective time of cooperative dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Provides that cooperative is legally dissolved when articles of dissolution have been filed with secretary of state.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to issue certificate of dissolution stating name, filing date, and dissolved status.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes judicial equitable relief and liquidation in member deadlocks, fiduciary breaches, creditor actions, or attorney general proceedings.

headings.title: Grounds for equitable relief or court liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates grounds for court-ordered equitable relief or liquidation upon application by cooperative, members, creditors, or attorney general.

headings.title: Consideration of cooperative financial condition
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to consider financial condition and prohibits denying relief solely because cooperative has operating net income.

headings.title: Consideration and ordering of lesser relief
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to evaluate whether lesser forms of equitable relief or partial liquidation would adequately resolve the dispute.

headings.title: Award of expenses for bad faith litigation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to award reasonable expenses and attorney fees against parties acting arbitrarily or in bad faith.

headings.title: Venue for judicial dissolution proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that dissolution proceedings be brought in the county where the cooperative's registered address is located.

headings.title: Member joinder in judicial proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that members need not be joined as parties unless personal relief is sought against them.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines judicial authority to grant injunctions and appoint receivers in dissolution, setting claim priority rules and asset distribution.

headings.title: Pre-hearing judicial powers and receiver appointments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes pre-hearing injunctions, receiver appointments, and asset preservation orders to maintain cooperative operations.

headings.title: Post-hearing receiver appointment and asset disposition
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to appoint receiver after hearing to collect assets, continue business, and conduct public or private sales.

headings.title: Statutory priority order for creditor claims
headings.reviewNote: Establishes priority order for applying assets to proceeding expenses, taxes, workers' compensation, employee wages, and general claims.

headings.title: Distribution of remaining assets to members
headings.reviewNote: Provides that assets remaining after receivership expenses and creditor claims are satisfied may be distributed to members.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes qualifications, bond requirements, litigation authority, and exclusive court jurisdiction for dissolution receivers.

headings.title: Receiver qualifications and bond requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires receiver to be a natural person or authorized business entity and to post a court-ordered bond.

headings.title: Receiver litigation capacity and exclusive jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes receiver to sue and defend and gives appointing court exclusive jurisdiction over the cooperative and property.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs involuntary cooperative dissolution actions brought by attorney general for fraud, illegal purposes, or persistent statutory violations.

headings.title: Grounds for attorney general dissolution action
headings.reviewNote: Specifies grounds for involuntary dissolution including fraudulent procurement, unauthorized purposes, repeat violations, and abandonment.

headings.title: Notice requirement and cure opportunity
headings.reviewNote: Requires forty-five days' prior notice from attorney general and prohibits action if the violation is timely corrected.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes court to require creditor claims filed under oath, establish bar dates, and mandate notice to cooperative creditors.

headings.title: Court order for filing verified creditor claims
headings.reviewNote: Permits court to require all creditors to file verified claims under oath with the court administrator or receiver.

headings.title: Court order setting claim deadline and creditor notice
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to fix a claim filing deadline at least one hundred twenty days after order filing and prescribe notice to creditors and claimants.

headings.title: Extension of deadline and bar of untimely claims
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court to extend the claim filing deadline before the fixed date and bars untimely claimants from sharing in cooperative property or assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive corporate registration report requirements, filing deadlines, registered agent changes, and family farm exemptions.

headings.title: Mandatory corporate registration report requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires domestic corporations and licensed foreign corporations to file an annual or biennial corporate registration report.

headings.title: Required contents of registration report
headings.reviewNote: Specifies report contents including corporate name, registered agent address, officer and director addresses, and headquarters.

headings.title: Filing schedule and annual due dates
headings.reviewNote: Establishes report due date based on month of incorporation or qualification, subject to changed month options.

headings.title: Signature requirement for registration report
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate registration reports to be signed by an officer or authorized person.

headings.title: Correction of officer and director errors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes correction of officer and director errors by filing a certificate of correction under section 351.049.

headings.title: Changing registered office or registered agent
headings.reviewNote: Permits changing registered agent or office on registration report with written agent consent and board resolution.

headings.title: Prescribed format for registration reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporate registration reports to be filed in the format prescribed by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Procedure for changing registration report month
headings.reviewNote: Allows corporations to change report filing month by designating desired month and paying twenty-dollar fee.

headings.title: Filing exemption for farm corporations
headings.reviewNote: Waives report filing requirement for authorized and family farm corporations when required corporate information has not changed.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs entry of court dissolution orders following asset distribution or exhaustion in supervised or involuntary proceedings.

headings.title: Entry of court order of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to enter dissolution order after debts and costs are paid and remaining assets distributed or exhausted.

headings.title: Effective time of judicial dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Provides that cooperative is legally dissolved upon entry of the court's dissolution order.

entries.reviewSummary: Forever bars unasserted creditor claims following dissolution proceedings while preserving remedies for post-proceeding liabilities.

headings.title: Unasserted creditor claims forever barred
headings.reviewNote: Bars creditors who fail to initiate proceedings or file claims during dissolution from subsequently suing or enforcing claims.

headings.title: Payment of liabilities incurred during dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires cooperative to pay liabilities incurred during dissolution before distributing assets and preserves remedies against offenders.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive statute governing foreign cooperatives, governing law, certificates of authority, registered agents, and unregistered transactions.

headings.title: Governing law and certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Applies domicile law to organization and affairs, limits foreign rights to domestic powers, and allows alternate names.

headings.title: Application for certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires certificate of authority before transacting business and specifies application contents and good standing certificates.

headings.title: Registered office and registered agent requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires continuous maintenance of a registered agent and filing of registered agent change reports pursuant to section 351.1027.

headings.title: Voluntary cancellation and administrative revocation of authority
headings.reviewNote: Governs voluntary cancellation or withdrawal of a foreign cooperative's certificate of authority and secretary of state revocation on sixty days' notice.

headings.title: Consequences of transacting business without authority
headings.reviewNote: Bars unauthorized foreign cooperatives from court proceedings while preserving contract validity and liability defenses.

headings.title: Activities not constituting transacting business
headings.reviewNote: Lists activities not constituting transaction of business in Missouri, while specifying that owning income-producing real or tangible personal property in the state does constitute transacting business.

headings.title: Action to restrain unauthorized business
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secretary of state or attorney general to bring action restraining unauthorized foreign cooperatives from business.

headings.title: Service of process on foreign cooperatives
headings.reviewNote: Directs that service of process on foreign cooperatives shall be executed in accordance with Missouri law.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes effective timing and delivery rules for notices to members and directors, electronic notices, affidavits, and failure to receive notice.

headings.title: Methods and effective timing of notice delivery
headings.reviewNote: Specifies valid notice delivery methods including facsimile, email, electronic network posting with separate notice, other consented electronic communication, U.S. mail, and overnight courier.

headings.title: Notice methods permitted for directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes delivering director notices using any statutory method upon the director's consent.

headings.title: Notice delivery to business entity members
headings.reviewNote: Requires notices mailed or delivered to entity members to be directed to an officer of the entity.

headings.title: Affidavit of electronic notice transmission
headings.reviewNote: Provides that an officer affidavit of electronic notice transmission is prima facie evidence of notice delivery.

headings.title: Member consent to electronic notice delivery
headings.reviewNote: Governs member written or electronic consent to electronic notices and cooperative reliance until revocation.

headings.title: General effective timing of statutory notices
headings.reviewNote: Declares that all statutory notices under the cooperative sections are deemed effective when given.

headings.title: Failure to receive notice and meeting validity
headings.reviewNote: Provides that member failure to receive regular or special meeting notice does not invalidate meeting actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes biennial filing of corporate registration reports, setting even- and odd-year qualification cycles, fees, and nonseverable rules.

headings.title: Biennial corporate registration report option
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes even- and odd-year corporations to elect biennial registration, setting fee schedules and technology trust fund fees.

headings.title: Biennial registration duration and annual switching
headings.reviewNote: Requires biennial registration to be maintained for twenty-four months and governs switching back to annual reporting.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and nonseverability clause
headings.reviewNote: Delegates rulemaking authority to secretary of state subject to chapter 536 review and nonseverability conditions.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines electronic records and signatures and establishes their legal effect and enforceability under cooperative statutes.

headings.title: Definitions for electronic records and signatures
headings.reviewNote: Defines electronic, electronic record, electronic signature, record, and signed for cooperative statutory purposes.

headings.title: Legal validity of electronic records and signatures
headings.reviewNote: Provides that records, signatures, and contracts shall not be denied legal effect or enforceability solely because of electronic form.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates that shares and bonds be issued only for money, labor, or property, voids fictitious issues, and regulates bonded indebtedness.

headings.title: Valid consideration required for shares and bonds
headings.reviewNote: Requires shares and bonds to be issued only for money, labor, or property received and declares fictitious issues void.

headings.title: Board approval required for bonded indebtedness
headings.reviewNote: Requires board approval to incur or increase bonded indebtedness without necessity of shareholder vote unless charter requires.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs board power to accept share subscriptions, payment installment calls, collection remedies, and forfeiture notice requirements.

headings.title: Board power to accept share subscriptions
headings.reviewNote: Grants board of directors power to accept or reject subscriptions for shares made before or after organization.

headings.title: Payment calls, default collection, and forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Allows corporate remedies for subscription default, including forfeiture of shares and prior payments after sixty days' written notice if default continues.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive statute authorizing creation and issuance of classes and series of stock, voting rights, redemption, dividends, and conversion.

headings.title: Authority to issue stock classes and series
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuance of stock classes or series with full, limited, or no voting powers, preferences, and special rights.

headings.title: Redeemable shares and nonredeemable voting class requirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes redeemable stock subject to section 351.200, requires at least one nonredeemable full-voting class with exceptions for regulated investment companies and license/franchise/exchange-member qualification redemptions, and sets redemption consideration.

headings.title: Preferred dividend rates and cumulative rights
headings.reviewNote: Permits preferred or special stock dividends at charter-fixed rates, payable on a cumulative or noncumulative basis before or concurrently with other classes.

headings.title: Liquidation preferences upon corporate dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Governs distribution preferences and rights of preferred or special stock upon voluntary or involuntary corporate dissolution.

headings.title: Conversion and exchange rights for stock
