headings.reviewNote: Authorizes charter provisions making stock convertible into or exchangeable for other classes or series of stock of the corporation on stated terms.

headings.title: Required certificate disclosures for stock classes
headings.reviewNote: Requires stock certificates to state or summarize preferences and powers or offer free written copies upon request.

headings.title: Filing certificate of designations with state
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes board resolution and certificate of designations filing requirements to establish series before issuance.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes creation and issuance of stock rights and options, setting contractual terms, board valuation discretion, and officer awards.

headings.title: Corporate authority to issue stock purchase options
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporations to create and issue rights or options to purchase shares of capital stock of any class.

headings.title: Terms, conditions, and consideration for options
headings.reviewNote: Governs option terms, pricing, duration, redemption, and makes director judgment as to consideration conclusive absent fraud.

headings.title: Delegation of option awards to officers
headings.reviewNote: Allows board to authorize officers to designate employee option recipients within total limits, prohibiting self-designation.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs consideration for par and no-par shares, deemed consideration upon share conversions, and conclusive board valuation.

headings.title: Consideration fixed for par and no-par shares
headings.reviewNote: Requires par value consideration not less than par and authorizes board or shareholders to fix consideration for no-par shares.

headings.title: Consideration and capital on share conversion
headings.reviewNote: Defines deemed consideration and stated capital adjustments upon conversion or exchange of shares and retirement of reacquired shares.

headings.title: Nonassessable shares and conclusive director valuation
headings.reviewNote: Declares fully paid shares nonassessable and makes director or shareholder valuation of consideration conclusive absent fraud.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes allocation of consideration for shares between stated capital and paid-in surplus and permits board capital increases.

headings.title: Allocation of consideration to stated capital
headings.reviewNote: Permits determining that only part of share consideration shall be stated capital, subject to par value and liquidation limits.

headings.title: Resolution timing for allocating no-par consideration
headings.reviewNote: Specifies resolution timing requirements for allocating consideration received for shares without par value.

headings.title: Board resolution increasing stated capital from surplus
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board of directors to increase stated capital by transferring amounts from surplus to capital.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates reduction of stated capital, limits on preference impairment, creation of paid-in surplus, and retirement of reacquired shares.

headings.title: Permitted methods for reducing stated capital
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates authorized statutory procedures for reducing corporate stated capital by share cancellation or par reduction.

headings.title: Limitation protecting preferential liquidation amounts
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits stated capital reductions below aggregate liquidation preferences of remaining shares with preferential rights.

headings.title: Capital reduction surplus designated paid-in surplus
headings.reviewNote: Classifies surplus created by or arising out of a reduction of stated capital as paid-in surplus.

headings.title: Restrictions on asset distributions from capital reduction
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits asset distributions out of stated capital reductions unless remaining assets exceed total debts and liabilities.

headings.title: Status of retired shares as authorized unissued
headings.reviewNote: Provides that retired shares become authorized and unissued shares unless charter prohibits reissue.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs redemption or purchase of corporate shares, stated capital restrictions, conversion retirement, and capital reduction procedures.

headings.title: Redemption of redeemable shares and capital application
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes redemption of redeemable shares and application of stated capital, prohibiting redemption causing insolvency.

headings.title: Board purchase and redemption of shares
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a corporation to redeem or purchase redeemable preferred shares out of surplus and retire the shares so acquired.

headings.title: Retirement of shares reacquired upon conversion
headings.reviewNote: Provides that shares reacquired upon conversion or exchange are retired and become authorized unissued shares.

headings.title: Capital reduction upon redemption or retirement
headings.reviewNote: Provides for automatic reduction of stated capital upon retirement and restores retired shares to authorized and unissued status unless the articles prohibit reissuance.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedure for redeeming pre-1943 non-redeemable preferred shares by shareholder vote, setting dissenter appraisal rights.

headings.title: Redemption of pre-1943 preferred shares procedure
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes redemption of pre-1943 preferred shares by three-fifths shareholder vote and establishes dissenter written objection deadlines.

headings.title: Agreed valuation and payment to dissenters
headings.reviewNote: Requires payment of agreed value within ninety days after redemption vote upon surrender of share certificates.

headings.title: Court petition for appraisal of dissenter shares
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissenting shareholder to petition court within sixty days to determine fair value of preferred shares.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs cash or property distribution of paid-in surplus to shareholders and application of surplus to eliminate corporate deficits.

headings.title: Restrictions on distributing paid-in surplus
headings.reviewNote: Restricts paid-in surplus distributions when cumulative preferred dividends remain unpaid or net assets fall below stated capital.

headings.title: Application of paid-in surplus to deficits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to apply paid-in surplus to reduce or eliminate operating deficits or asset value diminution.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates maintenance of books, records, and shareholder lists, granting inspection rights and imposing forfeiture penalties on refusing officers.

headings.title: Books and records and shareholder inspection rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to maintain complete accounts and records, granting shareholders right of examination for proper purposes.

headings.title: Officer penalty for refusing record inspection
headings.reviewNote: Imposes statutory civil forfeiture against corporate officers who wrongfully refuse or neglect shareholder inspection demands.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs place of shareholders' meetings, annual meeting schedules, remote participation, and call of special meetings.

headings.title: Location and remote shareholders' meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes meetings within or without state and permits remote participation without a physical location if authorized.

headings.title: Annual meeting for director elections requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual shareholders' meeting for election of directors and provides that failure to elect does not dissolve corporation.

headings.title: Call of special meetings of shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes special meetings of shareholders called by the board of directors or persons designated in articles or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes written notice requirements for shareholders' meetings, delivery timing by mail, and attendance as waiver of notice.

headings.title: Written notice requirements and timing
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice stating place, day, hour, and purpose delivered ten to seventy days before meeting.

headings.title: Delivery deemed upon mailing with postage
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that notice sent by mail is deemed delivered when deposited in United States mail with postage prepaid.

headings.title: Waiver of notice through shareholder attendance
headings.reviewNote: Provides that meeting attendance constitutes waiver of notice unless shareholder objects to unlawful convening at beginning.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive voting statute governing per-share votes, treasury stock voting prohibition, cumulative voting, proxies, and electronic transmission.

headings.title: One vote per share default standard
headings.reviewNote: Establishes default rule that each outstanding share is entitled to one vote on each matter submitted to shareholders.

headings.title: Prohibition on voting treasury and controlled shares
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits voting or counting for quorum shares belonging to the corporation or its controlled entities, preserving fiduciary voting.

headings.title: Cumulative voting for corporate directors
headings.reviewNote: Grants shareholders cumulative voting rights in electing directors unless articles or bylaws provide otherwise.

headings.title: Proxy validity duration and irrevocable proxies
headings.reviewNote: Regulates proxy duration, eleven-month expiration, irrevocable proxies coupled with an interest, and control share acquisition rules.

headings.title: Valid methods for executing proxy authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes proxy appointment by written execution or verifiable electronic transmission and defines electronic transmission standards.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires preparation and inspection of voting shareholder lists prior to meetings, preserving meeting validity, and imposing officer damages.

headings.title: Preparation and inspection of voting list
headings.reviewNote: Requires alphabetical shareholder voting list prepared ten days before meeting and available for inspection at registered office and meeting.

headings.title: Validity of meeting action preserved
headings.reviewNote: Provides that officer failure to prepare or produce voting list does not invalidate action taken at the meeting.

headings.title: Officer liability for failure to produce list
headings.reviewNote: Imposes liability on transfer officer for damages suffered by any shareholder on account of failure to prepare or produce voting list.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs voting of corporate shares held by other corporations, fiduciaries, receivers, and pledged shares.

headings.title: Voting shares owned by another corporation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes voting of shares standing in name of another corporation by designated officer, agent, proxy, or board determination.

headings.title: Voting shares held by fiduciaries or estates
headings.reviewNote: Governs voting of deceased person's shares by personal representatives and requires conservators or trustees to transfer shares into their names.

headings.title: Voting shares held by receivers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes receivers to vote shares standing in receiver's name or pursuant to appointing court orders.

headings.title: Voting rights for pledged shares
headings.reviewNote: Provides that pledgor retains voting rights until pledged shares are formally transferred into the name of the pledgee.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes shareholder meeting quorum requirements, voting instructions on proxy cards, and criminal infraction penalties for false proxies.

headings.title: Majority quorum requirement and successive adjournments
headings.reviewNote: Sets default quorum at a majority of outstanding voting shares and allows minority to successively adjourn meeting.

headings.title: Majority vote act, cumulative plurality, and proxy abstentions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes majority of represented voting shares as valid shareholder action (or plurality under cumulative voting for directors) and governs treatment of abstentions, uninstructed proxies, and default-instruction proxies.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for falsified proxy representation
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly representing a falsified proxy in any material respect as a criminal infraction.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes five percent quorum for single-share telephone corporations, geographic director districts, and majority quorum corporate acts.

headings.title: Five percent telephone corporation quorum and districts
headings.reviewNote: Establishes five percent quorum for single-shareholder telephone corporations and authorizes electing directors by geographic districts.

headings.title: Corporate acts valid upon majority of quorum
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes majority of quorum to take valid corporate action, excluding dispositions of substantially all corporate assets.

headings.title: Adjournment by majority of attendees without quorum
headings.reviewNote: Allows a majority of shareholders present to adjourn meeting from time to time without further notice if quorum is lacking.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates shareholder meeting adjournments and board postponements up to ninety days, defining terms and public notice standards.

headings.title: Adjournment of shareholder meetings up to ninety days
headings.reviewNote: Governs successive adjournments up to ninety days without new notice, requiring notice if longer or if new record date is fixed.

headings.title: Board postponement of shareholder meetings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to postpone shareholder meetings up to ninety days with written or public notice to voting shareholders.

headings.title: Statutory definitions for adjournment and postponement
headings.reviewNote: Defines adjournment, postponement, and public notice via press release or federal regulatory securities filings.

entries.reviewSummary: Limits shareholder liability to payment of full consideration, protects good faith assignees, and shields fiduciaries and pledgees.

headings.title: Shareholder obligation limited to unpaid consideration
headings.reviewNote: Limits shareholder obligation to unpaid consideration and protects good faith transferees without knowledge of unpaid amounts.

headings.title: Fiduciary and pledgee exemption from personal liability
headings.reviewNote: Exempts fiduciaries and collateral pledgees from personal shareholder liability, placing liability solely on estate funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive statute governing adoption and amendment of corporate bylaws, emergency bylaws, lines of succession, and officer protections.

headings.title: Shareholder and board authority to adopt bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Vests bylaw authority in shareholders unless charter vests power in board, permitting initial adoption by directors.

headings.title: Adoption of emergency bylaws during disasters
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to adopt emergency bylaws operative during nuclear disasters or attacks on the United States.

headings.title: Board establishment of emergency lines of succession
headings.reviewNote: Allows board to establish emergency lines of succession for officers and agents unable to discharge duties.

headings.title: Emergency change of corporate head office
headings.reviewNote: Permits board to relocate head office or designate alternative offices effective during an emergency.

headings.title: Officer and director immunity under emergency bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Shields officers, directors, and employees acting under emergency bylaws from liability except for willful misconduct.

headings.title: General bylaws operative unless inconsistent with emergency
headings.reviewNote: Maintains normal bylaws in effect during emergency except to the extent inconsistent with emergency bylaws.

headings.title: Board meeting notice during emergency situations
headings.reviewNote: Simplifies board meeting notice during emergencies, allowing notice only to directors practical to reach.

headings.title: Officers serving as directors for emergency quorum
headings.reviewNote: Deems corporate officers directors to the extent required to constitute a quorum during emergency meetings.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs stock certificate execution, facsimile signatures, uncertificated shares, and required statements on no-par certificates.

headings.title: Stock certificates and authorized facsimile signatures
headings.reviewNote: Requires share certificates or uncertificated resolutions, authorizing officer and transfer agent facsimile signatures.

headings.title: Required statements on no-par share certificates
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that certificates for shares without par value plainly state share counts without expressing nominal or par values.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs number and classification of directors, staggered terms, class voting powers, and shareholder removal procedures.

headings.title: Director terms and staggered board classification
headings.reviewNote: Provides for board size, annual elections, and classified boards with staggered terms of up to three years.

headings.title: Stock class rights to elect directors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes charter to confer rights on specific stock classes or series to elect directors with unequal voting powers.

headings.title: Shareholder removal of directors and cumulative voting
headings.reviewNote: Governs removal of directors with or without cause, protecting minority rights under cumulative and class voting structures.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates filling board vacancies and newly created directorships by remaining directors or class-elected directors.

headings.title: Filling board vacancies and new directorships
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remaining directors or sole director to fill vacancies and newly created directorships until next election.

headings.title: Vacancies in class-elected directorships
headings.reviewNote: Provides that vacancies among class-elected directors shall be filled by a majority of remaining directors elected by that class.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes court appointment of provisional director to break board deadlocks, setting qualifications, powers, compensation, and removal.

headings.title: Grounds for court appointment of provisional director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court to appoint provisional director upon petition of half the directors or one-third of shares in deadlocks.

headings.title: Qualifications, powers, compensation, and removal
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes impartiality requirements, director voting rights, court or agreed compensation, and three-year removal requests.

headings.title: Statutory deadlock status preserved during appointment
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that corporation remains deadlocked for statutory dissolution purposes notwithstanding provisional director appointment.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates contracts involving interested directors or officers, establishing safe harbors, quorum counting, compensation, and intent.

headings.title: Validity of interested officer and director transactions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that conflict transactions are not voidable if disclosed and approved by disinterested directors, shareholders, or fair.

headings.title: Counting interested directors for quorum purposes
headings.reviewNote: Permits interested directors to be counted in determining a quorum at board or committee meetings authorizing transactions.

headings.title: Director compensation setting not conflict of interest
headings.reviewNote: Declares that setting director compensation for corporate services is not an interested transaction or conflict of interest.

headings.title: Substantive law effect regularizing conflict transactions
headings.reviewNote: Declares legislative intent not merely to prevent voiding or voidability but to establish substantive law regularizing qualifying conflict transactions into arm's-length transactions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs regular and special board meetings, meeting notice, and board and committee actions by unanimous written consent.

headings.title: Notice of regular and special board meetings and waiver
headings.reviewNote: Governs notice for regular and special board meetings under the bylaws, waiver by attendance unless objecting at the start, and dispenses with stating purpose for regular meetings.

headings.title: Board action by unanimous written consent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board or committee action without a meeting by unanimous consent in writing or by electronic transmission as defined in section 351.245(5)(2).

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes board to consider community and social factors when evaluating acquisition proposals, defining terms and response discretion.

headings.title: Factors considered in evaluating acquisition proposals
headings.reviewNote: Permits board to consider employees, suppliers, customers, communities, and long-term shareholder interests during acquisitions.

headings.title: Definition of acquisition proposal
headings.reviewNote: Defines acquisition proposal to include tender offers, mergers, consolidations, or substantial asset purchases.

headings.title: Board response discretion and fiduciary scope
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that directors are not required to respond to proposals or precluded from taking other lawful actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive indemnification statute for corporate officials, covering third-party and derivative suits, mandatory defense, advances, and insurance.

headings.title: Third-party proceeding indemnification authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes indemnification of corporate officials in third-party proceedings if they acted in good faith with no unlawful cause.

headings.title: Derivative action indemnification and court approval
headings.reviewNote: Governs indemnification in derivative suits, barring recovery for negligence or misconduct absent court approval.

headings.title: Mandatory indemnification upon successful defense
headings.reviewNote: Mandates indemnification of expenses and attorney fees to the extent official is successful on merits or defense.

headings.title: Determination procedure for authorizing indemnification
headings.reviewNote: Specifies determination by disinterested directors, independent legal counsel, or shareholders for permissive indemnification.

headings.title: Advance payment of litigation defense expenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes advance payment of expenses upon receipt of an undertaking to repay if criteria are not satisfied.

headings.title: Non-exclusive character of statutory indemnification rights
headings.reviewNote: Provides that statutory indemnification is not exclusive of other rights under articles, bylaws, or agreements.

headings.title: Further indemnity authorized by articles or bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes broader indemnity in charter or shareholder bylaws, excluding knowingly fraudulent or willful misconduct.

headings.title: Corporate liability insurance and funding arrangements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes purchasing liability insurance, creating trusts, letters of credit, or self-insurance arrangements.

headings.title: Application to financial institutions and nonprofits
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory indemnification provisions to banks, trust companies, insurance entities, and nonprofit corporations.

headings.title: Indemnification rights in constituent merger entities
headings.reviewNote: Extends indemnification rights to officials of constituent predecessor corporations absorbed in mergers or consolidations.

headings.title: Definitions for employee benefit plan service
headings.reviewNote: Defines other enterprise, fines, and serving at request to encompass employee benefit plan duties and excise taxes.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs selection of corporate officers by directors, dual office holding, management duties, and board chairman authority as chief executive officer.

headings.title: Selection of officers and dual office holding
headings.reviewNote: Requires board to choose president and secretary, permitting multiple offices to be held by the same person.

headings.title: Officer authority and duties in corporate management
headings.reviewNote: Provides that officer authority and duties in corporate management are prescribed in bylaws or board resolutions.

headings.title: Board chairman authority as chief executive officer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board chairman to perform president duties if designated chief executive officer and filed with secretary of state.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates maintenance of continuous registered office and registered agent in Missouri and initial designation in articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Continuous registered office and agent requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to maintain a registered office and registered agent whose business office is identical with registered office.

headings.title: Initial registered office and agent in articles
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that address of initial registered office and name of initial registered agent be stated in articles of incorporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes statutory procedures for changing registered office or agent, filing statements with secretary of state, and agent office relocations.

headings.title: Corporate procedure for changing office or agent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporations to change registered office or agent by filing statement with written successor agent consent and board authorization.

headings.title: Effective time of change and corporate venue
headings.reviewNote: Provides that change takes effect upon filing and establishes corporate county residence at location of registered office.

headings.title: Registered agent procedure for changing address
headings.reviewNote: Allows registered agent to change street address for represented corporations upon written notice to corporation and filing statement.

entries.reviewSummary: Designates registered agent for service of process, authorizes secretary of state service upon default, and preserves alternate service methods.

headings.title: Service on registered agent or secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Designates registered agent for legal service and provides automatic appointment of secretary of state upon corporate default.

headings.title: Alternative service methods preserved by law
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory service provisions do not limit the right to serve process in any other lawful manner.

headings.title: Secretary of state record of served process
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to keep permanent record of all processes and notices served, recording times and actions taken.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes corporations to engage in any lawful business purpose unless restricted in charter, subject to special regulatory statutes.

headings.title: General lawful business purposes authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporations to engage in any lawful business unless expressly restricted to limited purposes in articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Compliance with other regulatory statutes
headings.reviewNote: Subjects corporations engaging in regulated businesses to all conditions and limitations of applicable regulatory statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes dissenter appraisal rights upon extraordinary asset sales, setting objection timelines, judicial appraisal petitions, and dissolution exceptions.

headings.title: Written objection and demand for fair value
headings.reviewNote: Entitles dissenting shareholders to demand fair value within twenty days of asset sale vote upon prior written objection.

headings.title: Agreed share valuation and payment timeline
headings.reviewNote: Requires payment of agreed share value within ninety days after authorization vote upon certificate surrender.

headings.title: Court petition for judicial valuation of shares
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissenter to file court petition within sixty days to determine fair value if agreement is not reached.

headings.title: Cessation of dissenter rights upon abandonment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that dissenting shareholder appraisal rights cease if corporation abandons or revokes asset sale authorization.

headings.title: Corporate disposition of acquired dissenting shares
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporation to hold and dispose of shares acquired from dissenting shareholders as it sees fit.

headings.title: Exception for sales during voluntary corporate dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Exempts asset sales made in course of liquidating corporate affairs during approved voluntary dissolution from appraisal rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive control share acquisition statute, requiring shareholder voting approval, disclosure statements, special meetings, and dissenter appraisal rights.

headings.title: Application of control share acquisition statute
headings.reviewNote: Applies control share statute to issuing public corporations unless charter or bylaws opt out before acquisition.

headings.title: Delivery of acquiring person disclosure statement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes acquiring person to deliver disclosure statement detailing identity, shareholdings, and proposed acquisition terms.

headings.title: Special meeting request and expense undertaking
headings.reviewNote: Allows acquiring person to request special shareholder meeting to determine voting rights upon giving expense undertaking.

headings.title: Notice requirements for special shareholder meeting
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes notice requirements and timing for special meeting to consider voting rights for acquired control shares.

headings.title: Shareholder voting approval for control shares
headings.reviewNote: Conditions control share voting rights on majority approval of disinterested voting shares and all outstanding voting shares.

headings.title: Dissenter objection and demand for fair value
headings.reviewNote: Grants dissenting shareholders appraisal rights if control shares are accorded full voting rights by shareholder vote.

headings.title: Agreed valuation and payment to dissenters
headings.reviewNote: Governs payment of agreed share value within ninety days after control share voting rights approval.

headings.title: Court petition for appraisal of control dissenters
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissenting shareholders to petition court within sixty days for judicial determination of fair share value.

headings.title: Preservation of other legal rights and remedies
headings.reviewNote: Preserves existing legal and equitable rights and remedies of corporations, directors, and shareholders.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive statute governing conversion of other business entities into Missouri corporations, approval requirements, filings, and property continuation.

headings.title: Definition of other entity for conversion
headings.reviewNote: Defines other entity to include LLCs, business trusts, partnerships, and foreign associations for corporate conversions.

headings.title: Conversion of other entity to corporation authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes other entities to convert to Missouri corporations upon complying with internal approvals and filing requirements.

headings.title: Required contents of certificate of conversion
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required statements in certificate of conversion including prior name, organization date, and corporate name.

headings.title: Effective time and organizational continuation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that entity is converted to corporation upon effective time and governed by Missouri corporate law.

headings.title: Preservation of pre-conversion obligations and personal liability
headings.reviewNote: Preserves pre-conversion entity obligations and liabilities and continues personal liability of equity owners for pre-conversion obligations.

headings.title: Continuation of entity identity and property title
headings.reviewNote: Deems converted corporation same entity as converting organization, vesting all property, rights, and debts without transfer.

headings.title: No dissolution or winding up required
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that conversion does not require converting entity to wind up affairs or constitute a dissolution.

headings.title: Prior approval required under governing documents
headings.reviewNote: Requires conversion approval in manner provided by converting entity governing documents or applicable governing law.

headings.title: Execution of certificate of conversion to corporation
headings.reviewNote: Requires certificate of conversion to be signed by person authorized to act on behalf of converting entity.

headings.title: Conversion or exchange of equity interests
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes exchanging or converting interests of converting entity into corporate shares, rights, cash, or cancellation.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs conversion of Missouri corporations to other business entities, board and shareholder approval, filings, property continuation, and nonprofit ban.

headings.title: Conversion of corporation to other entity authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic corporations to convert into domestic or foreign LLCs, statutory trusts, or partnerships.

headings.title: Board adoption and shareholder approval of conversion
headings.reviewNote: Requires board adoption of a conversion plan and unanimous approval by all outstanding shares of stock, whether voting or nonvoting.

headings.title: Certificate of conversion filing requirements
headings.reviewNote: Governs filing certificate of conversion with secretary of state and consenting to Missouri process service for foreign entities.

headings.title: Cessation of corporate existence upon conversion
headings.reviewNote: Provides that corporation ceases to exist as domestic corporation upon effective date of conversion certificate.

headings.title: Pre-existing corporate obligations unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Preserves prior obligations, liabilities, personal liability, and applicable choice of law after entity conversion.

headings.title: Conversion not deemed dissolution or winding up
headings.reviewNote: Provides that converting corporation is not required to wind up affairs and conversion does not constitute dissolution.

headings.title: Exchange and conversion of corporate shares
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes exchanging corporate shares for cash, property, or equity interests in the resulting business entity.

headings.title: Continuation of entity identity and vested property
headings.reviewNote: Deems converted entity same entity as corporation, preserving property titles, contracts, and creditor liens unimpaired.

headings.title: Conversion without shareholder vote before share issuance
headings.reviewNote: Dispenses with shareholder vote for conversion if no shares have been issued prior to board resolution.

headings.title: Prohibition on converting nonprofit corporations
headings.reviewNote: Explicitly prohibits converting nonprofit corporations into another business entity under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates short-form mergers of ninety-percent owned subsidiary corporations into parent or sister corporations without shareholder votes.

headings.title: Ninety percent subsidiary merger without shareholder vote
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes short-form merger of ninety-percent subsidiaries without shareholder vote upon board adoption of merger resolution.

headings.title: Name change of surviving corporation in merger
headings.reviewNote: Allows domestic surviving corporation to change its corporate name through provisions in the adopted plan of merger.

headings.title: Notice to minority shareholders and appraisal demand
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice to minority subsidiary shareholders and establishes twenty-day demand deadline for fair value payment.

headings.title: Limited applicability of section 351.455 appraisal provisions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that section 351.455 applies to a short-form merger effected under this section only to the limited extent provided in subsection 3.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes holding company reorganizations through subsidiary mergers without shareholder vote, defining terms, governance, and appraisal exemptions.

headings.title: Holding company merger reorganization without shareholder vote
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes holding company reorganization through direct subsidiary mergers without shareholder approval under statutory conditions.

headings.title: Definition of holding company for reorganizations
headings.reviewNote: Defines holding company as a direct or indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the domestic corporation from incorporation until consummation whose capital stock is issued in the merger.

headings.title: Carryover of takeover restrictions and prior stock certificates
headings.reviewNote: Carries over sections 351.407 and 351.459 restrictions and acquisition dates to the holding company without making non-interested shareholders interested, and deems prior certificates to represent holding company shares if the corporate name is unchanged.

headings.title: Filing articles of merger for holding reorganization
headings.reviewNote: Specifies filing and effectiveness requirements for holding company mergers (source note: section 351.440 was repealed by S.B. 288 in 2001).

headings.title: Inapplicability of dissenting shareholder appraisal rights
headings.reviewNote: Exempts holding company reorganizations under this section from dissenting shareholder appraisal rights under section 351.455.

headings.title: Preservation of short-form merger statutes
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that holding company reorganization provisions do not amend, alter, or restrict short-form mergers under section 351.447.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive dissenting shareholder appraisal statute for mergers and consolidations, setting objection rules, judicial appraisal, and exclusive remedies.

headings.title: Eligibility and written demand for fair value
headings.reviewNote: Defines dissenting shareholder eligibility and requires written objection and demand for fair value within twenty days.

headings.title: Payment upon surrender, demand contents, and presumed consent
headings.reviewNote: Requires the surviving or new corporation to pay fair value upon certificate surrender, requires the demand to state share number and class, and conclusively presumes consent if a shareholder fails to object, fails to demand within twenty days, or votes in favor.

headings.title: Meeting notice required for all record-date shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Requires giving notice under section 351.230(1) stating the meeting purpose to each shareholder owning stock as of the record date, whether or not entitled to vote.

headings.title: Agreement on share value between parties
headings.reviewNote: Governs agreed valuation within thirty days and payment timeline resulting in termination of shareholder interest.

headings.title: Court petition for judicial appraisal of shares
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissenting shareholder to petition court within sixty days for binding judicial determination of fair share value.

headings.title: Cessation of appraisal rights upon abandonment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that appraisal rights cease if merger or consolidation is abandoned or shareholders revoke authorization.

headings.title: Appraisal as exclusive shareholder remedy
headings.reviewNote: Makes statutory appraisal the exclusive remedy for dissenting shareholders to challenge the transaction, except in the case of fraud or lack of authorization for the transaction.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs mergers and consolidations between domestic and foreign corporations, regulatory compliance, legal effects, and effective dates.

headings.title: Merger or consolidation with foreign corporation authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes merger or consolidation of domestic and foreign corporations if permitted by laws of foreign incorporation jurisdictions.

headings.title: Legal effect of cross-border merger or consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that cross-border mergers have same legal effect as domestic mergers, requiring foreign survivors to comply with foreign laws.

headings.title: Effective date of merger with foreign survivor
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the merger or consolidation takes effect on the effective date in the foreign surviving or new corporation's state of domicile (section 351.440 does not apply), requiring a certifying document from that state.

entries.reviewSummary: Business combinations statute restricting mergers, asset sales, and share issuances with interested shareholders for five years, setting exemptions.

headings.title: Definitions for statutory business combinations
headings.reviewNote: Defines affiliate, associate, beneficial owner, business combination, control, interested shareholder, and voting stock.

headings.title: Five-year moratorium on interested shareholder combinations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits business combinations with twenty-percent interested shareholders for five years unless board approved combination or stock purchase.

headings.title: Requirements for combinations after five-year period
headings.reviewNote: Requires combinations after five years to receive majority disinterested shareholder approval or satisfy fair price formula.

headings.title: Exemptions from business combination restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Lists statutory exemptions including charter opt-outs, inadvertent acquisitions, pre-1985 holders, and unlisted corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates voluntary corporate dissolution proposed by board and approved by shareholders, setting notice rules and two-thirds voting threshold.

headings.title: Board proposal of dissolution to shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board of directors to propose voluntary dissolution for submission to shareholders.

headings.title: Adoption requirements and board recommendation
headings.reviewNote: Requires board recommendation to shareholders unless conflict exists and shareholder approval of dissolution proposal.

headings.title: Board authority to condition dissolution submission
headings.reviewNote: Empowers board of directors to condition its submission of the dissolution proposal on any basis.

headings.title: Meeting notice of proposed dissolution to shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice to all shareholders stating meeting purpose includes considering corporate dissolution.

headings.title: Two-thirds shareholder vote required for dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires dissolution proposal to be approved by at least two-thirds of votes entitled to be cast unless charter requires greater vote.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs discontinuation and dissolution of deadlocked fifty-fifty two-shareholder corporations, setting petition procedures and attribution rules.

headings.title: Circuit court petition for business discontinuance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes either fifty-percent shareholder to petition circuit court for business discontinuance or dissolution in deadlocks.

headings.title: Timeframes for agreement and court dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to dissolve corporation and appoint liquidating receiver unless shareholders file agreed plan within statutory deadlines.

headings.title: Tax attribution rules for related shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Applies federal tax attribution rules to treat shares owned by related taxpayers as held by a single shareholder.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes required statements in articles of dissolution delivered to secretary of state and sets effective dissolution timing.

headings.title: Required contents of articles of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Specifies contents of articles of dissolution including authorization date, shareholder voting tallies, or written consents.

headings.title: Effective time of corporate dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Provides that corporation is legally dissolved upon the effective date of its articles of dissolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs revocation of corporate dissolution within one hundred twenty days, authorization methods, filings, and retroactive resumption.

headings.title: One hundred twenty day revocation window
headings.reviewNote: Allows a corporation to revoke its voluntary dissolution within one hundred twenty days of its effective date.

headings.title: Authorization of dissolution revocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires revocation of dissolution to be authorized in the same manner as the original dissolution was approved.

headings.title: Filing articles of revocation of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivery of articles of revocation to the secretary of state setting forth corporate details and authorization.

headings.title: Effective date of revocation of dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that revocation of dissolution takes effect upon the effective date of the articles of revocation.

headings.title: Retroactive legal effect of dissolution revocation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that revocation relates back to dissolution date, allowing business to resume as if dissolution never occurred.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines permissible winding up activities of dissolved corporations and specifies corporate attributes and legal protections unaffected by dissolution.

headings.title: Scope of permissible winding up activities
headings.reviewNote: Limits business of dissolved corporation to collecting assets, discharging liabilities, and liquidating affairs for shareholders.

headings.title: Corporate attributes and proceedings unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Maintains property title, governance rules, litigation capacity, and registered agent authority, protecting name for one year.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs disposition of known claims against dissolved corporations, written notice requirements, claim bar deadlines, and fraudulent intent.

headings.title: Procedure for disposing of known claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires dissolved corporations to dispose of known claims by following statutory written notification procedures.

headings.title: Written notice requirements for known claimants
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes notice contents, mailing address, minimum one-hundred-eighty-day deadline, and notice that unfiled claims are barred.

headings.title: Statutory bar of unfiled or rejected claims
headings.reviewNote: Bars claims not delivered by deadline or claims rejected where claimant fails to sue within ninety days.

headings.title: Exclusion of contingent and post-dissolution claims
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that known claims do not include contingent liabilities or claims based on post-dissolution events.

headings.title: Standard for establishing fraudulent intent
headings.reviewNote: Defines fraudulent intent as showing sole or primary purpose of dissolution was to defraud shareholders or creditors.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates publication of unknown claim notices by dissolved corporations, two-year claim bar, enforcement remedies, and shareholder liability limits.

headings.title: Notice publication for unknown claims authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissolved corporations to publish newspaper and legal notice requesting presentation of unknown claims.

headings.title: Publication requirements and contents of notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires publication in county newspaper, legal publication, and electronic state notice with two-year bar warning.

headings.title: Two-year limitation bar on published claims
headings.reviewNote: Bars unknown, unnotified, contingent, and post-dissolution claims unless proceeding is commenced within two years of publication.

headings.title: Enforcement against assets and shareholder limits
headings.reviewNote: Limits claim enforcement to undistributed assets or pro rata distributed assets received by shareholders in liquidation.

headings.title: Fraudulent intent standard for unknown claims
headings.reviewNote: Defines fraudulent intent as demonstrating sole or primary purpose was to defraud shareholders or creditors.

entries.reviewSummary: Exempts insured claims from dissolution claim bar statutes, allowing appointment of defendant ad litem and limiting recovery to insurance coverage.

headings.title: Insured claims exempt from dissolution bar
headings.reviewNote: Exempts insured claims from dissolution notice bars, authorizing suits within normal limitations against appointed defendants ad litem.

headings.title: Enforceability limited to insurance proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Restricts judgment enforcement exclusively to available insurance coverage contracts and prohibits execution on shareholder assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes secretary of state administrative dissolution procedure, sixty-day cure notices, certificates of dissolution, and liquidation limits.

headings.title: Notice of grounds for administrative dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to serve written notice stating statutory grounds when grounds exist to dissolve a corporation.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of administrative dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to serve notice of administrative dissolution grounds and dissolve corporation if grounds are not corrected within sixty days (source note: word 'service' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Limitation to winding up business affairs
headings.reviewNote: Continues corporate existence following administrative dissolution but restricts activities solely to liquidation and winding up.

headings.title: Authority of registered agent preserved
headings.reviewNote: Provides that administrative dissolution does not terminate or impair the authority of the corporation's registered agent.

entries.reviewSummary: Comprehensive corporate reinstatement statute following administrative dissolution, tax clearances, retroactive relation back, and military waivers.

headings.title: Application for corporate reinstatement requirements
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes application contents, tax clearances from department of revenue and employment security, and fifty-dollar fee.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of corporate reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to cancel dissolution certificate and issue certificate of reinstatement upon proper application.

headings.title: Retroactive relation back of corporate reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that reinstatement relates back to dissolution date, validating interim actions as if dissolution never occurred.

headings.title: Fee and penalty waiver for military service
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secretary of state to waive reinstatement fees and penalties if failure to file was due to military service.

headings.title: Adoption of new corporate name upon reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Allows corporation to elect a new conforming corporate name if its prior name was reissued before reinstatement.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires written notice of reasons upon denial of reinstatement and authorizes administrative appeal under section 351.670.

headings.title: Notice of denial of corporate reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to serve written notice explaining specific reasons for denying corporate reinstatement.

headings.title: Right of appeal from reinstatement denial
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporation to appeal denial of reinstatement pursuant to statutory administrative appeal procedures in section 351.670.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes venue for judicial dissolution, dispenses with shareholder joinder, and authorizes preliminary injunctions and custodians pendente lite.

headings.title: Venue for judicial corporate dissolution actions
headings.reviewNote: Places venue in Cole County for attorney general actions and in county of registered or principal office for other parties.

headings.title: Shareholder joinder unnecessary in dissolution proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that shareholders need not be joined as parties to dissolution actions unless individual relief is sought.

headings.title: Preliminary injunctions and interim custodianship orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to issue preliminary injunctions, appoint custodians pendente lite, and preserve assets pending full hearing.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs court appointment of receivers or custodians in judicial dissolution, bond requirements, powers, redesignation, and compensation.

headings.title: Appointment and exclusive jurisdiction over receivers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to appoint liquidating receivers or managing custodians, vesting exclusive jurisdiction over corporate property.

headings.title: Receiver qualifications and bond requirement
headings.reviewNote: Permits appointment of individuals or corporations and authorizes court to require performance bonds.

headings.title: Powers and duties of receivers and custodians
headings.reviewNote: Defines powers of receivers to sell assets and sue and custodians to exercise board management powers.

headings.title: Redesignation between receiver and custodian
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to redesignate receivers as custodians or custodians as receivers based on corporate best interests.

headings.title: Compensation and expense allowances from assets
headings.reviewNote: Allows court to order compensation and expense disbursements paid to receiver, custodian, and counsel from corporate assets.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs entry and state filing of judicial dissolution decrees and mandates court-directed winding up and claimant notification.

headings.title: Entry and state filing of dissolution decree
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to enter dissolution decree upon establishing grounds and requires court clerk to deliver certified copy to secretary of state.

headings.title: Court-directed winding up and claimant notices
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to direct winding up, liquidation of assets, and notification of claimants in accordance with dissolution statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs filing request for corporate termination after resolving claims and distributing assets, twenty-dollar fee, and certificate issuance.

headings.title: Filing request for corporate termination requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires dissolved corporation to file termination request certifying claims are disposed of and remaining assets distributed.

headings.title: Filing fee for request for termination
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twenty-dollar statutory filing fee for filing request for corporate termination.

headings.title: Certificate of termination and legal cessation
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to issue certificate of termination, ending corporate existence and freeing corporate name.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires foreign corporations to obtain certificate of authority before transacting business and provides non-exhaustive list of exempt activities.

headings.title: Certificate of authority required for foreign corporations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits foreign corporations from transacting business in Missouri without obtaining a certificate of authority.

headings.title: Activities not constituting transacting business
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates non-transacting activities including litigation, board meetings, bank accounts, securities, debts, and isolated transactions.

headings.title: Non-exhaustive list of business activities
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory list of activities not constituting transacting business is not exhaustive.

entries.reviewSummary: Bars unauthorized foreign corporations from maintaining court proceedings, establishes annual fines for school funds, and preserves defense rights.

headings.title: Litigation bar for unauthorized foreign corporation
headings.reviewNote: Bars foreign corporations transacting business without authority from maintaining proceedings in Missouri courts until obtaining certificate.

headings.title: Application of litigation bar to successors
headings.reviewNote: Applies court proceeding bar to successors and assignees of causes of action arising from unauthorized business transactions.

headings.title: Court authority to stay pending proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to stay proceedings commenced by foreign corporations to determine whether certificates of authority are required.

headings.title: Civil penalty fine payable to schools
headings.reviewNote: Permits court to stay proceedings initiated by unauthorized foreign corporation until compliance is established (source note: word 'of' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Corporate validity and defense rights preserved
headings.reviewNote: Provides that lack of certificate of authority does not impair contract validity or prevent defending proceedings in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes application contents for foreign corporation certificates of authority, certificate of existence, and one-hundred-fifty-dollar fee.

headings.title: Required contents of authority application
headings.reviewNote: Lists required information in application including corporate name, domicile state, duration, principal office, and registered agent.

headings.title: Certificate of existence and statutory application fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires authenticated certificate of existence from domicile jurisdiction and payment of one-hundred-fifty-dollar state treasury fee.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires foreign corporations to obtain amended certificates of authority upon name or duration changes and applies original application standards.

headings.title: Mandatory amended certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires authorized foreign corporation to obtain amended certificate upon changing name, duration, or jurisdiction of incorporation.

headings.title: Application requirements for amended certificates
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory requirements and procedures for original certificates to applications for amended certificates of authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines scope of certificate of authority, grants parity of rights and liabilities with domestic corporations, and protects internal affairs.

headings.title: Transaction of business authorized by certificate
headings.reviewNote: Provides that certificate of authority authorizes foreign corporation to transact business subject to state revocation powers.

headings.title: Parity of rights, privileges, and liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Grants authorized foreign corporations same rights and subjects them to same duties and liabilities as domestic corporations.

headings.title: State regulation of internal affairs barred
headings.reviewNote: Explicitly prohibits Missouri from regulating the organization or internal affairs of authorized foreign corporations.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates corporate names of foreign corporations, fictitious names, distinguishable name standards, name consent, and merger carryovers.

headings.title: Foreign corporate name words and fictitious names
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes adding corporate designator words or adopting certified fictitious names if legal name is unavailable.

headings.title: Distinguishable corporate name requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign corporate names to be distinguishable from registered corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and reserved names.

headings.title: Application to use indistinguishable name
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes application to use indistinguishable name upon written consent and undertaking or final court judgment.

headings.title: Name carryover through merger or asset purchase
headings.reviewNote: Permits foreign corporation to use name of another corporation after merger, reorganization, or acquisition of assets.

headings.title: Name changes requiring amended certificates
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transacting business under changed non-conforming name until adopting conforming name and obtaining amended certificate.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs procedures for foreign corporations changing registered offices or agents and authorizes registered agents to change addresses.

headings.title: Foreign corporate procedure for changing office or agent
headings.reviewNote: Allows foreign corporations to change registered office or agent by delivering statement of change with agent consent.

headings.title: Registered agent procedure for address changes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered agent to change address of registered office for represented foreign corporations upon written notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes procedure for registered agent resignation for foreign corporations, secretary of state notices, and thirty-one-day termination.

headings.title: Resignation statement by registered agent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered agent of foreign corporation to resign by filing original and two copies of resignation statement.

headings.title: State notice of resignation to foreign corporation
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to mail copy and receipt to registered office and second copy to foreign corporate headquarters.

headings.title: Effective time of agency resignation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that agency appointment is terminated and registered office discontinued on thirty-first day following filing.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs service of process on foreign corporations through registered agents, certified mail to headquarters, effective dates, and alternatives.

headings.title: Registered agent as service representative
headings.reviewNote: Designates registered agent of foreign corporation as legal agent for service of process, notice, or demand.

headings.title: Service by mail upon corporate default
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service by certified or registered mail addressed to corporate secretary when registered agent is unavailable.

headings.title: Effective date of mail service of process
headings.reviewNote: Specifies when service by mail is perfected based on receipt date, return receipt signature, or five days post-deposit.

headings.title: Other lawful service methods preserved
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory foreign service provisions do not limit the right to serve process under other laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes application requirements for foreign corporate certificates of withdrawal, agent appointment of secretary of state, and process forwarding.

headings.title: Certificate of withdrawal required to withdraw
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits authorized foreign corporations from withdrawing from Missouri without obtaining certificate of withdrawal.

headings.title: Application for certificate of corporate withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Requires application stating business cessation, agent revocation, appointment of secretary of state, and address commitment.

headings.title: Service on secretary of state following withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Provides that service on secretary of state constitutes service on withdrawn foreign corporation and directs mailing copy.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs revocation of foreign corporate certificates of authority, sixty-day cure notices, secretary of state service agency, and agent survival.

headings.title: Notice of grounds for certificate revocation
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to serve written notice stating statutory grounds for revocation of certificate of authority.

headings.title: Issuance and filing of certificate of revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secretary of state to issue and file certificate of revocation if grounds are not cured within sixty days.

headings.title: Cessation of foreign corporate authority date
headings.reviewNote: Provides that foreign corporate authority ceases on effective date shown on certificate revoking authority.

headings.title: Secretary of state service agency following revocation
headings.reviewNote: Appoints secretary of state agent for service of process for causes arising while foreign corporation was authorized.

headings.title: Authority of registered agent preserved upon revocation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that revocation of certificate of authority does not terminate the authority of the registered agent.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs reinstatement of revoked foreign corporate certificates, tax clearance certificates, judicial review petitions, and court relief.

headings.title: Application for foreign corporate reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes application details, revenue department tax clearances, fifty-dollar fee, and delinquent charges for reinstatement.

headings.title: Issuance of certificate of foreign reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to cancel revocation certificate and issue certificate of reinstatement upon proper application.

headings.title: Judicial appeal from revocation of authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes foreign corporations to appeal revocation under section 351.670 by petitioning court to set aside revocation.

headings.title: Court authority to order summary reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to summarily order secretary of state to reinstate certificate of authority or grant appropriate relief.

headings.title: Appellate review of judicial reinstatement decisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that court final decisions in revocation appeals may be appealed as in other civil proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates production of electronic communication records by domestic and foreign corporations under search warrants and subpoenas, and civil immunity.

headings.title: Definitions for electronic communications records production
headings.reviewNote: Defines adverse result, electronic communication services, foreign corporation, Missouri corporation, and properly served.

headings.title: Application to subpoenas and search warrants
headings.reviewNote: Applies production provisions to court-issued warrants and subpoenas for electronic records in corporate possession.

headings.title: Five-business-day production deadline including out-of-state records
headings.reviewNote: Requires a foreign corporation to produce records sought by criminal process within five business days of receipt, including records located outside Missouri.

headings.title: Court orders for emergency record production
headings.reviewNote: Allows shortened production in less than five business days upon showing of adverse result, or a reasonable extension for good cause shown if no adverse result will occur.

headings.title: Motions to quash out-of-state process
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations seeking to quash or modify process to seek relief from issuing Missouri court.

headings.title: Authenticity verification by business record affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporations to verify authenticity of produced electronic records by verified business record affidavit.

headings.title: Missouri corporate compliance with out-of-state warrants
headings.reviewNote: Requires Missouri communication providers to comply with search warrants issued by other state courts.

headings.title: Immunity from civil actions for compliance
headings.reviewNote: Shields corporations, officers, and employees from civil causes of action for providing records pursuant to this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs secretary of state corporate record abstracts, certified abstracts, public copying, agency fee exemptions, telephone info, and preclearance.

headings.title: Abstract of corporate registration records and fee
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to furnish concise abstract of business entity records upon written request and five-dollar fee.

headings.title: Certification of record abstract under seal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certified abstract under official seal for additional five-dollar fee.

headings.title: Public inspection and copying of filed papers
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to make filed corporate papers available for public inspection and copying during office hours.

headings.title: Fee exemption for Missouri state agencies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts all agencies and departments of the state of Missouri from statutory abstract and certification fees.

headings.title: Free corporate status information by telephone
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to furnish basic corporate status, agent, and dates over telephone without charge.

headings.title: Preclearance examination of proposed corporate filings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes discretionary preclearance examination and reports upon proposed filings for fees up to fifty dollars.

headings.title: Discretionary post-incorporation filing without advance fee
headings.reviewNote: Permits secretary of state to accept post-incorporation filings without requiring advance payment of fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes employment of corporation registration clerks and supervisor, funding from state ordinary revenue, and attorney licensing.

headings.title: Employment of registration clerks and supervisor
headings.reviewNote: Empowers secretary of state to employ registration clerks, seasonal help, and an attorney supervisor of corporation registration.

headings.title: Compensation and travel expenses from state revenues
headings.reviewNote: Requires salaries of registration personnel and travel expenses to be paid from ordinary state revenues.

headings.title: Licensing requirement for employed corporate attorneys
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that all attorneys employed under this section be duly licensed under the laws of Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes criminal offense for knowingly signing false corporate documents intended for filing with secretary of state as class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Offense of signing false corporate document
headings.reviewNote: Declares it an offense to sign any corporate document knowing it is false in any material respect with intent to file.

headings.title: Classification of false signing as misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies the criminal offense of knowingly signing false corporate documents as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs statutory close corporations law application, interplay with professional corporations, and controlling effect over general corporate statutes.

headings.title: Application of general business corporate provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies chapter provisions to close corporations to the extent not inconsistent with statutory close corporation sections.

headings.title: Application to professional corporations under chapter
headings.reviewNote: Extends close corporation provisions to electing chapter 356 professional corporations except for inconsistent provisions.

headings.title: Non-electing corporations unaffected by close provisions
headings.reviewNote: Preserves general corporate laws for corporations that do not affirmatively elect statutory close corporation status.

headings.title: Effective application and controlling effect of law
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory close corporation provisions to all post-1990 electing corporations absent valid agreements to the contrary.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines statutory close corporations, sets two-thirds shareholder election thresholds, dissenter rights, and shareholder qualifications.

headings.title: Definition of statutory close corporation
headings.reviewNote: Defines statutory close corporation as one whose articles of incorporation contain a statement designating close corporation status.

headings.title: Election of status and dissenter rights
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporations with fifty or fewer shareholders to elect close status by two-thirds class vote with dissenter rights.

headings.title: Shareholder qualifications set forth in articles
headings.reviewNote: Allows articles of incorporation to define shareholder qualifications by specifying eligible or ineligible classes of persons.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates conspicuous close corporation notices on share certificates, uncertificated notices, legal effect on transferees, and document copies.

headings.title: Conspicuous notice required on share certificates
headings.reviewNote: Requires conspicuous statement on close corporation share certificates referencing transfer restrictions and governance documents.

headings.title: Written notice required for uncertificated shares
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation to send written notice containing close corporation disclosures to holders of uncertificated shares.

headings.title: Statutory satisfaction of transfer restriction notice
headings.reviewNote: Declares that statutory close corporation notice satisfies all legal requirements that share transfer restrictions be noted.

headings.title: Binding legal effect on share claimants
headings.reviewNote: Binds claimants to restriction documents if notice was provided or if the claimant had actual knowledge or notice.

headings.title: Duty to furnish document copies without charge
headings.reviewNote: Requires statutory close corporations to furnish copies of articles, bylaws, and agreements to shareholders without charge.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes general prohibition on transfer of close corporation shares and lists statutory permitted transfer exceptions.

headings.title: General prohibition on transfer of shares
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits voluntary or involuntary transfers of close corporation shares except as expressly authorized by statute.

headings.title: Statutory exceptions permitting share transfers
headings.reviewNote: Permits transfers to corporation, immediate family, written unanimous consents, fiduciaries in death or bankruptcy, and mergers.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates share transfers after first refusal by close corporation, third-party offer requirements, shareholder voting, and allocation.

headings.title: First refusal offer required before share transfer
headings.reviewNote: Requires selling shareholder with a bona fide third-party cash offer to offer shares to the corporation first.

headings.title: Eligibility requirements for third-party offeror
headings.reviewNote: Defines third-party offeror eligibility regarding tax qualification maintenance and avoidance of personal holding company taxes.

headings.title: Delivery of offer and special meeting vote
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivery of offer to corporation and calling special meeting where purchase must be approved by majority vote.

headings.title: Notice of acceptance and delivery of shares
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes timelines for corporate acceptance within seventy-five days, counteroffers, and specific enforcement of delivery.

headings.title: Allocation of purchased shares among shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes allocating purchased shares among approving shareholders or granting remaining class holders first purchase options.

headings.title: Right to transfer shares upon corporate rejection
headings.reviewNote: Allows selling shareholder one hundred twenty days to transfer offered shares to third-party offeror upon corporate rejection.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs legal effect of attempted share transfers in breach of transfer prohibitions and provides corporate purchase option.

headings.title: Attempted transfer in breach deemed ineffective
headings.reviewNote: Declares attempted share transfers in violation of binding transfer prohibitions legally ineffective.

headings.title: Corporate purchase option for unnotified transfers
headings.reviewNote: Grants corporation thirty-day option to purchase shares from transferee if prohibition was not binding due to lack of notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs charter election for compulsory share purchase upon shareholder death, modification rules, dissenter rights, and waivers.

headings.title: Compulsory share purchase upon shareholder death
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes estate representative to compel corporate share purchase or dissolution if provided in articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Charter modification of compulsory purchase provisions
headings.reviewNote: Requires modifications to compulsory purchase provisions to be set forth or referred to in articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Approval vote required for charter amendment
headings.reviewNote: Requires two-thirds vote of each class or series of shares to adopt, modify, or delete compulsory purchase provisions.

headings.title: Dissenters' rights upon modification or deletion
headings.reviewNote: Entitles negative voting shareholders to assert statutory dissenters' rights if charter amendment terminates purchase rights.

headings.title: Written waiver of compulsory purchase rights
headings.reviewNote: Allows a shareholder to waive personal and estate compulsory purchase rights through a signed writing.

headings.title: Independent purchase agreements and remedies preserved
headings.reviewNote: Preserves independent shareholder purchase agreements and common law remedies outside the statutory provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Prescribes procedures for exercising compulsory share purchase rights upon shareholder death, meeting calls, pricing, and rejection.

headings.title: Written notice exercising compulsory purchase right
headings.reviewNote: Requires estate representative to deliver written notice to corporation within one hundred twenty days of death.

headings.title: Special meeting and purchase offer approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires calling special meeting within twenty days where majority of disinterested voting shares must approve purchase offer.

headings.title: Written offer delivery and pricing terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires written purchase offer delivered to estate representative within seventy-five days specifying price and payment terms.

headings.title: Allocation of purchased shares among shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes allocating purchased estate shares among approving shareholders or granting remaining class holders purchase options.

headings.title: Effect of agreed price and terms and dissolution on default
headings.reviewNote: Provides that fixed price and terms in the articles, bylaws, or a written agreement govern compulsory purchase unless the purchaser defaults, in which event the seller may commence a dissolution proceeding under section 351.790.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs judicial proceedings to compel share purchase or dissolution, fair value determinations, modification, and default remedies.

headings.title: Court proceeding to compel share purchase
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court proceeding to compel purchase or dissolution, vesting plenary and exclusive jurisdiction in court.

headings.title: Court valuation and order of purchase or dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to determine fair share value and order purchase or empower petitioner to have corporation dissolved.

headings.title: Petition for modification of purchase terms
