headings.reviewNote: Allows corporation to petition court for modified terms based on changed financial or legal ability to complete purchase.

headings.title: Dissolution petition upon thirty-day default
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes seller to petition for corporate dissolution if purchaser fails to make court-ordered payment within thirty days.

headings.title: Recovery of cure payments from defaulter
headings.reviewNote: Entitles any person making payment to cure or prevent default to recover full reimbursement from defaulting party.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes unanimous close corporation shareholder agreements regulating management, eliminating boards, shifting liabilities, and partnerships.

headings.title: Unanimous written shareholder agreements authorized
headings.reviewNote: Allows all shareholders of a statutory close corporation to agree in writing to regulate corporate management and affairs.

headings.title: Permitted scope of shareholder agreements
headings.reviewNote: Validates agreements that eliminate boards, restrict director powers, grant weighted voting, or treat entity as partnership.

headings.title: Transfer of director liability to decisionmakers
headings.reviewNote: Relieves directors of statutory liability and imposes liability on persons in whom management discretion is vested.

headings.title: Charter statement required to eliminate board
headings.reviewNote: Requires articles of incorporation to contain express statement to eliminate board of directors under shareholder agreement.

headings.title: Charter statement required for dissolution rights
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity of shareholder dissolution rights under agreement on inclusion of statement in articles of incorporation.

headings.title: Unanimous approval required to amend agreement
headings.reviewNote: Requires unanimous written approval of all shareholders to amend shareholder agreement unless agreement provides otherwise.

headings.title: Subscribers acting as shareholders before issuance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes share subscribers to execute shareholder agreement if shares were not yet issued when agreement was made.

headings.title: Other shareholder agreements not prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory shareholder agreement section does not prohibit other agreements between or among shareholders.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs operation of statutory close corporations without a board of directors, unanimous charter amendments, shareholder duties, and board reinstitution.

headings.title: Operation without board of directors authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes close corporations to operate without a board if articles of incorporation contain an express statement.

headings.title: Unanimous approval to eliminate board of directors
headings.reviewNote: Requires unanimous approval of all shareholders, subscribers, or incorporators to amend charter to eliminate board.

headings.title: Management powers and shareholder liability rules
headings.reviewNote: Vests corporate powers in shareholders, shields non-voting shareholders from liability, and allows designated director filings.

headings.title: Reinstitution of board of directors by amendment
headings.reviewNote: Requires an amendment terminating a board-dispensation election to specify the number, names, and addresses of directors or who will perform board duties under section 351.310.

entries.reviewSummary: Dispenses with bylaws if provisions are included in charter or shareholder agreements and mandates immediate bylaws upon close status termination.

headings.title: Bylaws optional if provisions in charter or agreement
headings.reviewNote: Relieves close corporations from adopting bylaws if required provisions appear in charter or shareholder agreements.

headings.title: Immediate bylaw adoption upon close status termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation lacking bylaws to adopt bylaws under section 351.290 immediately upon terminating close status.

entries.reviewSummary: Fixes annual meeting date for close corporations on business day following May thirty-first and dispenses with meeting absent shareholder request.

headings.title: Statutory annual meeting date following May thirty-first
headings.reviewNote: Establishes default annual meeting date as first business day after May thirty-first unless otherwise provided.

headings.title: Annual meeting optional absent shareholder request
headings.reviewNote: Dispenses with annual meeting requirement unless one or more shareholders deliver written notice requesting meeting.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires two-thirds class vote for close corporation mergers, consolidations, or extraordinary asset sales terminating or creating status.

headings.title: Two-thirds class vote required for mergers
headings.reviewNote: Requires approval by two-thirds of votes in each class or series for mergers terminating or creating close corporation status.

headings.title: Two-thirds class vote for extraordinary asset disposition
headings.reviewNote: Requires two-thirds class approval for sale, lease, or disposition of all or substantially all assets outside ordinary course.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs termination of statutory close corporation status by charter amendment, two-thirds class voting requirement, and dissenter rights.

headings.title: Termination of close status by charter amendment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes terminating close status by charter amendment deleting close statement and addressing board reinstitution.

headings.title: Two-thirds class vote required for termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires termination amendment to be approved by holders of at least two-thirds of votes in each class or series.

headings.title: Dissenters' rights upon termination of close status
headings.reviewNote: Entitles shareholders who voted against termination amendment to assert statutory dissenters' rights under sections 351.870 to 351.930.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs statutory effect of terminating close corporation status, application of general corporate law, and preservation of shareholder rights.

headings.title: Application of general corporate law upon termination
headings.reviewNote: Subjects corporation terminating close status to all general corporate provisions of chapter 351 or chapter 356.

headings.title: Preservation of shareholder rights and agreements
headings.reviewNote: Preserves shareholder agreement and charter rights following close status termination unless invalidated by other state law.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes charter provisions granting shareholders options to dissolve close corporations at will or upon contingencies and thirty-one-day liquidation.

headings.title: Shareholder option to dissolve corporation at will
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes charter option for designated shareholders to dissolve corporation upon thirty-one days' notice of intent to dissolve.

headings.title: Unanimous approval required for dissolution option
headings.reviewNote: Requires unanimous shareholder or subscriber approval to amend charter to add, change, or delete shareholder dissolution option.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes shareholder petitions for judicial relief against illegal, oppressive, or deadlocked conduct in statutory close corporations.

headings.title: Grounds for shareholder judicial relief action
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates grounds for court petition including illegal, oppressive, fraudulent, or deadlocked management conduct injuring shareholders.

headings.title: Venue and plenary jurisdiction for relief actions
headings.reviewNote: Places venue in county of principal or registered office, granting circuit court plenary and exclusive jurisdiction.

headings.title: Exhaustion of agreed nonjudicial remedies required
headings.reviewNote: Requires petitioning shareholder to exhaust agreed nonjudicial dispute remedies before commencing court action.

headings.title: Dissenters' rights deadlines and proceeding bar
headings.reviewNote: Requires commencement of relief action before statutory payment demand deadlines or the judicial proceeding is barred.

headings.title: Statutory remedies in addition to other rights
headings.reviewNote: Provides that, except as limited by subsections 3 and 4, a shareholder's right to proceed and remedies under sections 351.855 to 351.865 are in addition to any other right or remedy.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes court-ordered share buyouts as extraordinary relief in close corporation shareholder disputes, setting valuation rules and default dissolution.

headings.title: Court-ordered share purchase as extraordinary relief
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to order purchase of petitioner shares by corporation or other shareholders if ordinary relief is inadequate.

headings.title: Fair value determination and installment terms
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to determine fair value, specify purchase and installment terms (including subordination, security, and covenants not to compete), require share delivery, limit remaining claims, and order dissolution under section 351.865 on default (source note: word 'convenant' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Petition for modification of purchase terms
headings.reviewNote: Allows any party to petition court for modification of purchase terms based on changed financial or legal conditions.

headings.title: Seller asset rights if dissolution follows failed purchase
headings.reviewNote: Preserves the selling shareholder's same rights and priorities in corporate assets as if the sale had not been ordered if dissolution occurs because the purchase was not completed.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes judicial dissolution of close corporations where statutory grounds exist and lesser relief is inadequate, considering business conditions.

headings.title: Grounds for judicial dissolution of close corporation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court dissolution upon finding grounds under section 351.494 or that all other relief ordered under section 351.855 or 351.860 has failed to resolve the dispute.

headings.title: Consideration of financial condition and operating profits
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to consider corporate financial condition among other relevant evidence, and bars refusing dissolution solely because of accumulated earnings or current operating profits.

entries.reviewSummary: Lists statutory corporate actions triggering shareholder dissenters' appraisal rights and restricts dissenter challenges absent fraud.

headings.title: Statutory corporate actions triggering dissenters' rights
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates triggering events including mergers, asset sales, and charter amendments altering preferences, redemption, or votes.

headings.title: Exclusivity of remedy absent fraud or illegality
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits dissenting shareholders from challenging corporate action unless the transaction is unlawful or fraudulent.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs exercise of dissenters' rights by record shareholders as to fewer than all shares and by beneficial shareholders.

headings.title: Record shareholder partial dissent requirements
headings.reviewNote: Allows record shareholder to dissent as to fewer than all shares if dissenting for all shares of any one beneficial owner.

headings.title: Beneficial shareholder exercise of dissenters' rights
headings.reviewNote: Permits beneficial owner to assert dissenters' rights upon submitting record holder consent for all beneficially held shares.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires meeting notice to inform shareholders of dissenters' rights and written notice when corporate action is taken without a vote.

headings.title: Meeting notice of potential dissenters' rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires shareholder meeting notice to state potential dissenters' rights and include statutory copy of appraisal statutes.

headings.title: Dissenters' notice for actions without shareholder vote
headings.reviewNote: Directs corporation to send written dissenters' notice to eligible shareholders when triggering action is taken without a vote.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires dissenting shareholders to deliver written notice of intent to demand payment before meeting vote and refrain from voting in favor.

headings.title: Pre-vote written notice of intent to dissent
headings.reviewNote: Requires dissenting shareholders to deliver written notice of payment demand before vote and refrain from voting in favor.

headings.title: Loss of payment rights upon failure to comply
headings.reviewNote: Provides that shareholder failing to deliver pre-vote notice or voting in favor is not entitled to dissenter payment.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates timing, delivery, and required contents of written dissenters' notices sent by corporation following action approval.

headings.title: Delivery of written dissenters' notice to dissenters
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation to deliver written dissenters' notice to all shareholders who complied with section 351.890 after proposed action is authorized at a meeting (source note: word 'corporation' appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Required contents and forms in dissenters' notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires sending dissenters' notice within ten days of approval or action and prescribes required contents, demand forms, deposit locations, transfer restrictions, thirty-to-sixty-day deadlines, and statutory copies.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires dissenting shareholders to demand payment, certify beneficial ownership date, deposit certificates, and retain shareholder rights.

headings.title: Shareholder payment demand and certificate deposit
headings.reviewNote: Requires dissenter to demand payment, certify pre-announcement acquisition date, and deposit certificates by deadline.

headings.title: Retention of shareholder rights pending corporate action
headings.reviewNote: Provides that dissenter retains all shareholder rights until cancelled or modified by consummation of corporate action.

headings.title: Loss of dissenter entitlement for failure to demand
headings.reviewNote: Disentitles shareholder to fair value payment if shareholder fails to demand payment or deposit certificates by deadline.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes corporation to restrict transfer of uncertificated shares upon payment demand and preserves dissenter rights until consummation.

headings.title: Transfer restrictions on uncertificated dissenter shares
headings.reviewNote: Allows corporation to restrict transfer of uncertificated shares from receipt of payment demand until action is taken.

headings.title: Retention of rights for uncertificated share holders
headings.reviewNote: Provides that beneficial dissenter of uncertificated shares retains all shareholder rights until action is consummated.

entries.reviewSummary: Requires immediate corporate payment of estimated fair value to complying dissenters, accompanied by financial statements and appraisal info.

headings.title: Immediate payment of estimated fair share value
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation to pay complying dissenters estimated fair value immediately following action or payment demand.

headings.title: Financial statements and explanation accompanying payment
headings.reviewNote: Mandates accompanying payment with corporate financial statements, fair value explanation, and notice of rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs return of deposited certificates and release of transfer restrictions if corporate action is not taken within sixty days.

headings.title: Return of share certificates upon sixty-day inaction
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation to return certificates and release transfer restrictions if proposed action is not taken within sixty days.

headings.title: New dissenters' notice required for delayed action
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation to send a new dissenters' notice if it takes proposed corporate action after returning certificates.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes withholding fair value payment from dissenters acquiring shares after public announcement date and provides offer procedures.

headings.title: Withholding payment from after-acquired share dissenters
headings.reviewNote: Permits corporation to withhold payment from dissenters acquiring beneficial ownership after initial announcement date.

headings.title: Offer of fair value to after-acquired shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation withholding payment to estimate fair value after taking action, pay accepting dissenters in full satisfaction, and accompany its offer with the fair value estimate statement and notice of section 351.925 demand rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs dissenter rights to estimate fair value and demand payment upon corporate default or undervaluation and thirty-day waiver deadlines.

headings.title: Dissenter estimate of fair share value
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dissenter to demand own estimate of fair value if corporate payment is insufficient or delayed sixty days.

headings.title: Thirty day waiver of demand right
headings.reviewNote: Provides that dissenter waives right to demand payment unless written notification is given within thirty days of corporate payment or offer.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs judicial appraisal proceedings commenced by corporation within sixty days, venue, party joinder, appraisers, and dissenter judgments.

headings.title: Sixty day deadline for court appraisal proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation to commence court proceeding within sixty days of unsettled demand or pay amount demanded in full.

headings.title: Venue for judicial appraisal of shares
headings.reviewNote: Places venue in county of corporation's principal or registered office or in county of merged domestic entity.

headings.title: Mandatory joinder of all unsettled dissenters
headings.reviewNote: Requires corporation to make all unsettled resident and nonresident dissenters parties to the judicial proceeding.

headings.title: Plenary jurisdiction and court appointment of appraisers
headings.reviewNote: Vests plenary jurisdiction in court, authorizing appointment of appraisers and granting dissenters civil discovery rights.

headings.title: Judgment for excess fair value awarded dissenters
headings.reviewNote: Entitles each dissenter party to judgment for amount fair value exceeds corporate payment, plus fair value of withheld shares.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes non-attorney corporate employee representation in administrative agency proceedings and establishes general severability of statutory provisions.

headings.title: Corporate representation by non-attorney employee authorized
headings.reviewNote: Empowers designated employee to represent corporation in agency proceedings, restricting brief filing and legal arguments to licensed attorneys.

headings.title: Statutory severability of act provisions
headings.reviewNote: Declares the provisions of this act severable pursuant to section 1.140 (source note: 'This act' refers to H.B. 1432, 1990).
